raw.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

The Technology Operations Analyst function empowers Work Dynamics (WD) accounts to gain insights, maximize decision-making capabilities, and ensure high customer satisfaction by driving optimal value from the JLL technology platform. It ensures operational excellence of Work Dynamics on-account business applications and data platforms including technology performance management, compliance, and security.

The Technology Operations Analyst is a vital role within the Work Dynamics Technology Enablement team, responsible for the day-to-day operational support and maintenance of technology systems and applications for assigned Work Dynamics accounts. The Technology Operations Analyst provides technical expertise, advanced troubleshooting, and user support to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of technology services. This role is essential for maintaining system performance, security, and compliance. The Technology Operations Analyst works closely with the Service Delivery Manager to ensure seamless service delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Systems Administration & Maintenance: Perform system administration tasks, including software installations, updates, and configurations. Ensure systems are running optimally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshooting & Support: Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical support to resolve system and application issues. Escalate complex issues to senior team members as needed.
  • User Training & Documentation: Develop and deliver user training programs to enhance user knowledge and adoption of technology systems. Create and maintain clear and concise documentation for system configurations and procedures.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for optimization and improvement. Implement changes to enhance system efficiency and reliability.
  • Compliance & Auditing: Assist with compliance and auditing activities, ensuring systems meet security and regulatory requirements.
  • Scripting & Automation: Develop and implement scripts and automation tools to streamline operational tasks and improve efficiency.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the Service Delivery Manager and other team members to ensure effective communication and collaboration on service-related issues and projects.
  • Security Awareness & Support: Support the implementation of security policies and procedures. Identify and report potential security vulnerabilities.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in IT operations or a related role.
  • Strong technical skills in systems administration, troubleshooting, and user support.
  • Experience with scripting and automation tools.
  • Understanding of IT security principles and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Familiarity with the JLL Work Dynamics technology ecosystem is a plus.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL v4) are a plus.

Location:

Remote –Bogota, COL

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.

JLL Privacy Notice

Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. Generally the personal information we collect from you are for the purposes of processing in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavour to keep your personal information secure with appropriate level of security and keep for as long as we need it for legitimate business or legal reasons. We will then delete it safely and securely.

For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view ourCandidate Privacy Statement.

For additional details please see our career site pages for each country.

Jones Lang LaSalle (“JLL”) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process – including the online application and/or overall selection process – you may email us at . Job Title: Creative Professional (Domain Expert)

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (United States or Canada)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required. Your creative and professional judgment is what matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Draw on your experience in a creative role to evaluate real-world briefs, concepts, and finished work.
  2. Review AI-generated creative output (written content, design direction, concepts, scripts, storyboards, edits) for originality, craft, and fit to the brief.
  3. Create realistic scenarios based on your own work, including briefs, revision rounds, and feedback from stakeholders.
  4. Identify weaknesses in how AI handles creative judgment, taste, and collaboration, and provide detailed feedback.
  5. Document findings clearly and offer actionable recommendations to our customer’s team.
  6. Contribute to the development of AI training datasets using your professional expertise.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Currently employed full time in a creative role, such as graphic designer, illustrator, video or audio editor, animator, photographer, writer, editor, or art director.
  2. Based in the United States or Canada.
  3. At least 2 years of professional experience in your field.
  4. A portfolio or body of work you can draw from.
  5. Strong creative judgment and the ability to explain your reasoning.
  6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and thoroughness.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience in a studio, publishing house, media company, or in-house creative team.
  2. Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
  3. Familiarity with emerging trends in AI, automation, or creative production.

Job Title: Social Work & Community Services Professional (Domain Expert)

Job Type: Contractor

  2. Based in the United States or Canada.
  3. At least 2 years of professional experience in the field.
  4. Strong judgment on sensitive topics, with a clear understanding of confidentiality.
  5. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and thoroughness.
  6. Ability to explain your reasoning.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. BSW, MSW, or an equivalent degree or license.
  2. Experience in child welfare, health care, housing, or schools.
  3. Familiarity with emerging trends in AI, automation, or digital tools in human services.

raw.excerpt: What You’ll Do Avalara is accelerating delivery of AI-enabled capabilities across our compliance platform to improve customer experience, increase engineering velocity, and scale global operations efficiently.
raw.description:
What You’ll Do

Avalara is accelerating delivery of AI-enabled capabilities across our compliance platform to improve customer experience, increase engineering velocity, and scale global operations efficiently. As transaction volumes, product complexity, and AI-driven initiatives expand, we require senior engineers who can both deliver high-quality distributed systems and materially increase leverage through applied AI.

This role exists to elevate platform reliability, accelerate AI-enabled product delivery, and raise engineering standards across a globally distributed team. The successful candidate will directly influence delivery speed, system resilience, and AI adoption within engineering workflows and product capabilities.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This Senior Software Engineer will:

  • Increase engineering velocity through structured AI-assisted development and automation.
  • Improve platform reliability, observability, and scalability across distributed systems.
  • Deliver AI-enabled product capabilities that improve customer efficiency and insight.
  • Raise team performance standards through technical leadership, mentoring, and strong ownership.
  • Contribute to a culture of Bar Raisers who improve talent density and execution quality.

This role improves not only output, but how work gets done , embedding AI into development workflows and strengthening architectural discipline.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Responsibilities

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing backend and frontend systems that support Avalara’s global compliance platform.
  • Increase development efficiency by embedding AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and architectural exploration into daily workflows.
  • Contribute to AI-enabled product features that enhance automation, data processing, and customer-facing intelligence.
  • Improve deployment frequency, code quality, and automated test coverage through CI/CD and engineering best practices.
  • Reduce production incidents and improve system observability through thoughtful architecture and proactive monitoring.
  • Lead technical design discussions and influence architectural decisions for complex distributed systems.
  • Raise the performance of the team through mentoring, peer feedback, and high standards of ownership and accountability.
  • Collaborate effectively with global engineering, product, and business stakeholders in English.

12-Month Success Signals

Within the first 12 months, this engineer will:

  • Deliver multiple production-ready features, including at least two AI-enabled capabilities that improve customer or operational outcomes.
  • Increase engineering velocity through AI-assisted workflows and automation (measurable improvement in cycle time, test coverage, or deployment frequency).
  • Reduce production defects or incidents through improved architecture and observability.
  • Demonstrate Bar Raiser impact by mentoring engineers and elevating technical standards across the team.
  • Contribute to improved system scalability and reliability supporting global transaction growth.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Required Qualifications

  • Must have:
    • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken) for global collaboration.
    • 4 years of bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in computer science or equivalent Engineering.
    • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience aligned to senior-level scope.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Java building scalable APIs and services. Any additonal experience with Python or Node or .NET (C#) is desirable.
    • Flexible to switch between Technology.
    • Experience with AWS cloud environments.
    • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab).
    • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
    • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
    • Strong knowledge of automated testing strategies.
    • Demonstrated hands-on AI usage that improved measurable business or engineering outcomes.
  • Nice to have:
    • Strong experience with React (TypeScript) building maintainable frontend applications will have advantages.
    • Experience designing and operating distributed systems and RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in SaaS or enterprise-scale platforms.
  • Experience in compliance, financial systems, or regulated domains.
  • Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives.

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, we hire only Bar Raisers , individuals who improve the average performance of the team.

This engineer will:

  • Hold high standards of ownership, quality, and accountability.
  • Improve the performance of peers through coaching, sharing and example.
  • Leave systems, processes, and documentation stronger than they found them.

AI Expectations

This role requires applied AI capability, not passive familiarity.

The successful candidate must:

  • Demonstrate measurable impact from AI usage (e.g., reduced cycle time, increased automation, improved quality).
  • Apply AI responsibly and securely in both engineering workflows and product features.
  • Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and implement governance-aware best practices.
  • Share AI techniques and elevate adoption across the team.
  • Bring new ideas to improve Product and Process using AI.

Casual AI usage is insufficient. AI must materially improve outcomes.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

raw.description:
About WCG

WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.

Why WCG

At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.

What we offer:

Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accountsResources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance toolsInvestment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on-the-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education supportTime to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick timePathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG

We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.

Job Summary

The Program Director is accountable for the overall management of assigned WCG client relationships, as well as the coordination and governance of those partnerships. This role will be responsible to provide program oversight and develop Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) to ensure our WCG solutions meet our customers’ needs. The Program Director will also assist with building a foundation and unifying the integration of our service delivery to provide the customer with seamless service experience.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

  • Prepare annual operational plans, reports and executive briefs for our WCG customer programs.
  • Plan, schedule and manage periodic client governance meetings as defined per client.
  • Manage all Service Level Agreements (SLA’s), Governance Agreements, and required reporting for clients.
  • Set objectives & goals for the program and track progress, setbacks, and overall performance.
  • Manage relationship and communicate program status to client and WCG executive stakeholders.
  • Responsible for the coordination and oversight of cross-functional staffed programs
  • Maintain processes to ensure program documentation, reports and plans are relevant, accurate and complete.
  • Provide strategic vision and strong leadership while directing WCG client programs.
  • Assess and manage program risks while collaborating with operations to enact plans of action
  • Track, record, compile and analyze program results and performance data.
  • Provide strategic support to both sites and sponsors, serving as a liaison to ensure cross-functional performance and Return on Investment (ROI) to our customers.
  • Attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the position.
  • Support the sales team and operations throughout the sales and onboarding life cycles (i.e., presenting on sales calls, supporting deck preparation, liaising with sales to compile answers to client questions, etc.)
  • Serve as a subject matter expert when called upon by the sales team.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification a plus.

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of program management experience with a proven record of accomplishment of successful delivery with customer impact, in leading and managing teams, meeting with customers to gather, analyze and assess requirements, and coordinating and managing multiple programs & efforts simultaneously.
  • 5+ years of experience working on pharmaceutical industry projects requiring 21 Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) Part 11 Compliance.
  • 3+ years of experience in Account Management/Client Relationship Management.
  • Background in Clinical Research and technology preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal & organizational skills and able to effectively communicate with cross-functional teams and at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to lead through influencing and negotiating.
  • Must be able to organize diverse activities in a changing fast-paced environment.
  • Solid conflict resolution, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong aptitude for conceptual & critical thinking, project management and business awareness.
  • Proven ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Proficient in developing plans & budgets, as well as, tracking, planning capacity and reporting.
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel, Access and PowerPoint as well as Adobe, Visio and Microsoft Project and the ability to produce detailed reports and presentations using these tools.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: 10% to 20%

Pay Range

USD $106,830.00 - USD $166,000.00 /Yr.

EEOC Statement

WCG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. WCG complies with the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Act and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. We promote a "One WCG" culture where all are welcome, respected, valued, and empowered to make a difference every day to advance clinical research.

What You'll Do

As a Staff Software Development Engineer on the Connectors Engineering – SAP Portfolio team, you'll be the senior, hands-on technical resource for AvaTax's most complex SAP implementations. You'll work directly with Certified Implementation Partners (CIPs) and customer IT/Basis/ABAP teams to diagnose and resolve technical issues that arise while deploying AvaTax and related products across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA (Private Cloud), and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.

You'll own problems end-to-end rather than routing them — debugging ABAP code, dumps, and BAdI/enhancement logic, navigating SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud's Clean Core extensibility model (BTP, CDS views, restricted BAdIs), and resolving the large majority of issues yourself. You'll escalate to Connector Engineering only when an issue is a confirmed product defect, packaging it with the reproduction steps, logs, and traces engineering needs to act quickly. In doing so, you'll protect engineering's roadmap capacity, strengthen Avalara's credibility with high-stakes enterprise SAP partners, and help build the runbooks and mentoring that raise the broader SAP Tax Technology team's troubleshooting capability over time.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Technical Ownership & Direct Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the primary technical owner on partner-led and direct SAP implementation projects, joining CIP calls with the depth and authority to resolve issues on the spot.

  • Diagnose technical issues from functional consultants, partners, and customers — spanning connector behavior, ABAP customization, BTP configuration, BAdI/enhancement logic, SAP Basis, or customer-specific code — and resolve them directly in the majority of cases.

  • Escalate to Connector Engineering only for confirmed product defects, with full reproduction steps, logs, and ABAP traces included.

  • Own issues to full closure; success is measured by resolution, not hand-off speed.

SAP Technical Troubleshooting & Debugging

  • Debug live issues across SAP ECC, S/4HANA Private Cloud, and S/4HANA Public Cloud, including ABAP debugging, dump analysis, and connector/interface tracing.

  • Review and advise on custom BAdI implementations, user exits, and enhancement logic partners/customers use to extend Avalara connector functionality (e.g., FlexMapper custom field mapping, address validation BAdIs).

  • Navigate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud's extensibility model (BTP, CDS views, restricted BAdI framework) to find compliant technical paths where standard extensibility is limited.

  • Apply first-principles troubleshooting to distinguish connector defects from customer configuration, custom code, or platform issues.

  • Understand tax calculation, VAT, and e-invoicing concepts — including country-specific mandates such as real-time reporting and clearance models — well enough to troubleshoot where they intersect with SAP tax determination and connector behavior.

Integration & API-Level Diagnostics

  • Use REST API tooling (Postman, SOAP UI) and log/trace analysis to reproduce issues with evidence, inspecting JSON/XML payloads, authentication, and sync vs. async processing.

  • Analyze connector, ERP-native, and internal logs/traces to pinpoint failure points and separate configuration, data, platform, and product-defect causes.

  • Prepare escalation-ready diagnostic artifacts (repro steps, payloads, logs, error codes, business impact) for the rare genuine engineering escalations.

Client & Partner-Facing Technical Engagement

  • Join customer- and partner-facing calls to explain technical analysis, progress, and options in clear, non-engineering language.

  • Build trusted relationships with CIP technical teams and customer ABAP/Basis resources, positioning Avalara as a strong technical partner on high-stakes, multi-year SAP engagements.

  • Proactively manage expectations on complex or long-running issues, keeping stakeholders aligned on status and next steps.

  • Communicate the boundary of support clearly — guiding on approach and diagnosis without taking ownership of partner/customer-owned custom code.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Partner with Connector Engineering to keep engineering focused on product development rather than ad hoc firefighting.

  • Work with the functional SAP Tax Technology team to raise their independent debugging capability through runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and training.

  • Document recurring technical patterns (common ABAP errors, BAdI pitfalls, BTP/CDS restrictions) to build institutional knowledge and reduce repeat escalations.

  • Contribute technical input to roadmap and prioritization discussions based on patterns seen across implementations.

AI-Driven Impact

  • Identify and implement opportunities for AI to accelerate technical triage, such as AI-assisted analysis of ABAP dumps, logs, and traces.

  • Design and build AI-powered triage agents that auto-classify escalations, surface likely root cause, and recommend next steps or routing.

  • Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into troubleshooting workflows with appropriate safeguards, observability, and deterministic fallbacks — especially for compliance-critical tax processes.

  • Use AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Cursor or similar) to speed up documentation, runbooks, and issue write-ups, and continuously evaluate emerging AI tools relevant to SAP technical support.

Operating Model

  • Operate as a self-starter with minimal day-to-day direction, proactively identifying and acting on technical risk to go-lives, partner trust, or competitive exposure.

  • Exercise sound judgment on the rare cases that genuinely require engineering involvement — independent resolution is the strong default.

  • Maintain high accountability on time-sensitive, high-visibility implementations where delays can affect go-live dates and partner relationships.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Minimum Requirements

  • B.S. in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in SAP technical roles, with direct, hands-on ABAP development and debugging experience, aligned to scope and level of this role.
  • Proven experience with SAP BTP, CDS views, and the SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud extensibility model (including its BAdI restrictions).
  • Direct experience with SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA (Private Cloud) integrations, ideally including third-party/ISV connector or middleware integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug in live customer/partner environments and to read and interpret ABAP dumps, traces, and enhancement/BAdI code.
  • Strong client-facing skills: comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise customers and Certified Implementation Partner teams, translating deep technical detail into clear guidance for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent troubleshooting instincts — able to quickly isolate root cause across a complex chain of SAP configuration, custom code, connector logic, and integration middleware.
  • Hands-on fluency with integration and API diagnostic tooling — Postman, SOAP UI, REST/SOAP API testing, and reading JSON/XML payloads, request/response cycles, and standardized error codes to reproduce and evidence issues.
  • Working knowledge of tax calculation, VAT, and e-invoicing concepts, including how country-specific e-invoicing mandates affect SAP document flows.
  • Self-starter who can operate with significant autonomy, manage competing high-priority issues, and drive them to resolution without constant oversight — and without defaulting to engineering escalation as the first move.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on applied AI capability: able to give specific examples of using AI to materially improve speed, quality, or scale of technical work, with the ability to explain tool/approach choices and relevant risk and governance considerations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a partner-facing or consulting role (SI, ISV, or SAP-focused consultancy) involving enterprise, multi-year implementations.
  • Working knowledge of Avalara's SAP connector architecture, FlexMapper, or willingness to ramp up quickly.

What You'll Do

As Senior Director of Product Management, Returns, you will be a leader in our Product team responsible for Avalara’s global Returns business — one of our most critical and expansive product lines. This portfolio spans the full breadth of returns compliance: Managed Returns, Premium Returns, Property Tax, Excise Tax, DAVO, MyLodgeTax, VAT Reporting, and Managed VAT Reporting. You will partner with our Returns GM leadership to establish OKRs and a multi-year roadmap to provide clarity on product vision, and to challenge and inspire an ambitious team of Product Managers. You will help drive strategic cross-product and cross-functional initiatives to transform our business and customer experience, focused on efficiency to enable growth.

  • Partner with the general managers for Returns, Property Tax, and Excise and cross-functional leaders to align strategy, priorities, and execution across a global, multi-product portfolio.

  • Interact with customers and Avalara subject matter experts to understand market needs across U.S. and international returns compliance — from sales tax and excise to VAT and property tax.

  • Work closely with product managers to drive consolidated strategies and roadmaps to ensure cohesion across team members and multiple product lines.

  • Work with product managers on goal setting and plan execution.

  • Be an evangelist of the Avalara product strategy, particularly our shift from singular product tasks to agentic, cross-product workflows that replace manual, fragmented compliance processes.

  • Articulate a clear and compelling product vision for the Returns group that spans both domestic and global compliance obligations.

  • Define metrics that measure key business objectives, including customer satisfaction, compliance accuracy, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.

  • Partner with other Avalara leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, UX/Design, Compliance Operations, Marketing, and Sales to drive strong relationships that foster goal achievement and issue resolution.

You will thrive in this role if your instincts are solution-oriented when presented with a wide range of complex problems that have a big impact on driving innovation across the broader organization. You like being seen as a partner across the many teams you will work with, and you foster an open and transparent communication style which is valued at all levels from Product Managers to Executives. Your demeanor and approach to product management allow you to take a step back and look at unique challenges holistically to define pervasive problems and articulate priorities to propose solutions across a diverse group of stakeholders with high expectations of you and your team. You are a demonstrated AI experimenter — someone who actively explores and applies agentic tooling and automation to accelerate product outcomes and customer value.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Lead high-ownership, high-accountability product teams across a broad global portfolio — setting the standard for what it means to deeply know your business and fully own the customer and product experience.

  • Motivate, inspire, and grow your people. Consistently hire A-players, earn their loyalty, and grow their careers.

  • Champion the transition from discrete, single-product tasks to agentic cross-product workflows — helping define the future of how Avalara’s compliance platform serves customers end-to-end.

  • Drive strong cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Compliance Operations, and Sales to deliver products that are reliable, scalable, and market-leading.

  • Ensure accountability across the entire product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

  • Represent the voice of the customer at every stage; ensure product decisions are grounded in data, customer evidence, and market insight.

  • 10+ years of related product management experience and 5+ years of leadership and management experience.

  • Track record of leading a team of 5–10 directs or matrixed employees, and experience influencing product, design, and engineering teams of 40–200+.

  • Demonstrated success leading products and product teams from inception through launch for solutions that target small, mid, and enterprise-level businesses.

  • Deep domain expertise in tax compliance, specifically in one or more of the following: Managed Returns (U.S. or EMEA), Property Tax, Excise Tax, Lodging/Hospitality, DAVO, VAT Reporting. Expertise across more than one area is a strong differentiator.

  • Broad understanding of global tax compliance frameworks, financial technology, and SaaS environments.

  • A problem-solving mindset with a demonstrated appetite for AI experimentation — someone who actively applies emerging tools and agentic systems to reimagine how products get built and delivered.

  • Experience with agile development methodologies and commonly used tools such as Jira, Confluence, etc.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Ready to be a leader with a company committed to pushing the limits of advanced technologies? At General Dynamics Mission Systems, we create the products and services that help service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. The work we do is so advanced, it’s often classified. If you want to put your talent in the spotlight, it’s waiting for you right now, right here.

We apply advanced technologies to solve our customers’ missions across cyber, RF, undersea, space and other domains.

As an Advanced Program Finance Specialist, you’ll analyze financial performance, support business planning and help identify opportunities to improve outcomes and mitigate risk. You’ll partner with program management, functional leaders and program finance on forecasts, budgets, and financial reporting. Your insights will help guide decisions across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform month-end close activities for assigned areas and support the Controller in monitoring profit and loss and balance sheet account activity for profitability and cash flow analysis.
  • Prepare, analyze and evaluate financial information for program and department budgets, forecasts, cost pools, pricing, planning and control.
  • Monitor program costs, investigate variances and communicate findings to stakeholders.
  • Analyze financial performance to identify and report risks, issues and opportunities.
  • Lead and coordinate processes for collecting, consolidating, analyzing and developing departmental and cost pool budgets, capital budgets, Strategic Business Plans, New Business Funds and/or Rate Control.
  • Prepare ad hoc analyses to support programs and special projects.
  • Monitor ASC 606 revenue recognition and earnings rate reviews for compliance with generally accepted accounting principles and GDMS policies, procedures and requirements.
  • Conduct studies and summarize recommendations related to investment and business opportunities, future trends, and the potential impact of government requirements and financial regulations.
  • Perform complex analyses involving multiple factors, interpret data to assess current and future financial performance, and provide management with consultative, tactical advice.
  • Consolidates or oversees the consolidation and roll-up (integration) of financial statements for company’s Corporate Finance, including supplemental schedules and reports for the area of assignment.
  • Identify opportunities to apply artificial intelligence to support continuous improvement and innovation.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Highly proficient analytical skills, including the ability to analyze data, reconcile financial accounts and translate findings into recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of government contracting and financial requirements, including Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), the Truth in Negotiations Act, government accounting and the Sarbanes-Oxley Act.
  • Knowledge of revenue recognition, including ASC 606, and long-term accounting for government contracts.
  • Knowledge of Earned Value methodology and Earned Value Management systems.
  • Knowledge of internal financial practices, including General Ledger Accounting, Rates and Compliance, Cost Proposal, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets and Travel.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, as well as Hyperion, Essbase and Oracle.
  • Highly proficient written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate financial information to a range of stakeholders.
  • Strong leadership, management, and influence skills.
  • Effective time management and the ability to meet multiple deadlines for various stakeholders.

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

USD $115,000.00 - USD $120,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. This role is a high-impact, hands-on individual contributor role focused on architecting mission-critical, high-throughput ELR platforms while fundamentally transforming how customers and partners connect to Avalara.   • Proven track record designing and delivering developer tools, integration platforms, self-service customer onboarding engines, or enterprise integration middleware.
  • Strong proficiency in modern backend languages and runtimes (such as Java, C#/.NET Core, Go, or Python).
  • Deep mastery of API design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), event-driven architectures (Kafka, EventBridge, RabbitMQ), and microservices design patterns.
  • Experience with complex schema definitions, validation, and payload transformations (e.g., XML/XSD, JSON Schema, UBL, EDI).
  • Extensive experience with AWS (or other major cloud providers) and modern DevOps practices (Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS, CI/CD).
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex domain logic and regulatory requirements with clarity and robust software abstraction.

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience in E-Invoicing, Live Reporting, Peppol, EDI/B2B data exchange, or adjacent fintech/compliance/tax domains.
  • Hands-on experience building ERP connectors or middleware integration tooling for enterprise platforms (SAP, NetSuite, Workday, Dynamics 365, Oracle).
  • Experience architecting systems with strict data sovereignty, digital signing (PKI, HSM, X.509 certificates), and cryptographic verification requirements.
  • Experience designing or integrating generative AI and ML models into production data pipelines or developer tooling.
  • Clear builder mindset—passionate about code, architecture, and solving hard technical challenges as an individual contributor.

  • Deliver foundational platforms and tools that measurably decrease enterprise customer onboarding time and integration friction.

What You'll Do

Avalara is seeking a senior-level indirect tax analyst to join our Premium Returns for Communications (PRS) team. This role is designed for a highly experienced, technically sophisticated tax professional who is ready to operate at an elite level, serve our most complex customers, and actively raise the bar for the team around them. As a senior contributor, you will bring deep multi-jurisdictional communications tax compliance expertise, a proven ability to drive process and automation improvements, and the mindset of someone who makes every team they join stronger.

The Senior Tax Analyst II is the primary point of contact for a select portfolio of Premium Returns for Communications customers with highly complex compliance needs. You will own the end-to-end relationship and filing lifecycle for your accounts, serve as a trusted escalation resource, and lead process improvement and automation initiatives that benefit the broader Premium Returns for Communications team. This role requires a professional who is self-directed, proactive, and deeply committed to both customer outcomes and team excellence.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

  • Protects customer revenue through accurate, on-time state, local, and federal communications tax compliance support.
  • Reduces compliance risk by applying deep jurisdictional expertise and robust variance, exception, and notice management.
  • Increases operational scale by designing and refining Premium Returns for Communications workflows, data ingestion patterns, and automation that reduce manual effort.
  • Enhances customer trust as a knowledgeable, proactive, senior point of contact for complex portfolios on Premium Returns for Communications products.
  • Raises team capability by mentoring junior analysts and sharing documentation, process improvements, and AI best practices.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Own end-to-end preparation, review, and filing of complex, multi-jurisdiction communications tax returns – including state, local, federal, and regulatory obligations (e.g., USF, E911, FUSF, PUC) – for assigned customer portfolios, achieving on-time performance aligned to SLAs.
  • Serve as primary compliance contact for assigned customers using Premium Returns for Communications products, handling advanced questions and escalations with minimal supervision.
  • Analyze transactional and configuration data across AvaTax, Returns Console, and source systems to identify discrepancies, filing risks, and root causes before submission.
  • Design and continuously improve Premium Returns for Communications workflows (data ingestion, validation, approvals, filing, archiving) to reduce manual touches, rework, and notice volume.
  • Perform and improve month-end reconciliations and variance analysis to align reported liability with customer expectations.
  • Engage state, local, and federal jurisdictions on behalf of customers to resolve complex compliance issues, notices, and exceptions.
  • Participate in QA/UAT for new forms, filing automation, and Premium Returns for Communications Returns Console features; provide clear, risk-based feedback from a compliance perspective.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Onboarding, Professional Services, and CX to strengthen compliance execution and the Premium Returns for Communications experience.
  • Mentor and coach junior analysts on complex jurisdictions, Premium Returns for Communications best practices, customer communication, and AI-enabled workflows.

What You'll Need to be Successful

Qualifications (Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax AND 7+ years of hands-on practical experience in multi-jurisdiction indirect tax compliance – both are required; a degree alone or experience alone is not sufficient.
  • Proven experience preparing and filing complex, multi-state communications tax returns, including exposure to federal and state regulatory obligations such as USF, E911, FUSF, and PUC filings.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of communications-specific tax complexity, including multi-jurisdictional rate structures, exemption management, and telecom billing configurations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, PivotTables, Power Pivot or similar) and demonstrated ability to analyze large, complex datasets.
  • Experience working across multiple systems and tools (e.g., AvaTax for Communications, Returns Console/ARA, ERP or billing platforms, CSV/API extractors) with the ability to troubleshoot data and configuration issues end-to-end.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills; able to operate calmly and methodically under strict filing deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex tax and system topics in clear, simple language to non-experts.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining quality.
  • Proven application of AI tools in a professional context to improve efficiency, accuracy, or customer experience (e.g., analysis, summarization, drafting, documentation) – this is a required capability, not a nice-to-have.

12-Month Success Signals

  • Independently manage a portfolio of complex, multijurisdictional Premium Returns for Communications customers with minimal escalation.
  • Achieve consistent 100% on-time filing performance (or agreed SLA targets) for assigned portfolios.
  • Maintain high accuracy with visible reductions in rework, variances, and notices relative to baseline.
  • Implement at least one documented AI-driven workflow or process improvement adopted by the broader team.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of AvaTax for Communications, Returns Console, and Premium Returns for Communications, including data flows and key configuration patterns.
  • Contribute meaningfully to at least one cross-functional initiative (e.g., product feedback loop, automation pilot, training series) with clear, documented outcomes.
  • Recognized by peers and leaders as a go-to SME for Premium Returns for Communications-based compliance in at least one or two critical domains (e.g., specific jurisdictions, customer segment, workflow type).

Bar Raiser Expectations

At Avalara, every senior hire is expected to make the team better than it was before they arrived. This is not a maintenance role – it is a role for someone who raises the bar for everyone around them. You will join this team and leave it stronger: stronger processes, stronger knowledge, stronger people, and a higher standard of excellence. If you are the kind of person who makes teams better, this is the right opportunity.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability for customer outcomes, deadlines, and quality – not just your own portfolio but the health of the team’s work.
  • Exercise sound judgment in decisions that impact customers, scalability, and risk, using data and AI insights where appropriate.
  • Act as a go-to SME for critical Premium Returns for Communications compliance functions or customers, leading through influence across teams.
  • Leave processes, workflows, and documentation stronger than you found them by identifying issues, proposing solutions, and driving them to completion.
  • Elevate peer performance through mentoring, knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and modeling Avalara’s AI-first, customer-obsessed culture.
  • Set and hold a higher standard – not by authority but by example.

AI Bar Raiser Expectations

This candidate is expected to join Avalara as an AI Bar Raiser. That means you bring AI fluency, habits, and applied expertise that exceed the current team’s capability – and you are expected to actively elevate the team’s AI capability through your work, coaching, and innovation. Generic AI tool usage is not sufficient for this role. You must be the person who raises the standard for what “good” looks like when it comes to AI-enabled compliance work.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate data analysis, reconciliations, exception review, and return preparation while maintaining or improving quality.
  • Use AI to draft clear, professional customer and jurisdiction communications; apply judgment and domain expertise before sending.
  • Summarize complex issues, root cause analyses, and action plans with AI to improve clarity and reduce preparation time for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and implement at least one AI-enabled workflow enhancement (e.g., standardized prompts, variance review patterns, notice response templates) within the first 12 months.
  • Quantify measurable AI impact such as reduced review hours, faster cycle times, or lower notice/rework rates.
  • Apply AI responsibly in alignment with Avalara security, privacy, and compliance standards.
  • Proactively share AI methods, prompt patterns, and lessons learned so that the team’s collective AI capability grows because you are here.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

What You'll Do

Role Summary

As Avalara scales its AI-first enterprise systems, workflows, and automation footprint, we must reimagine how work is automated, orchestrated, and continuously improved across every function. This role exists to establish and engineer an enterprise-grade AI automation and transformation ecosystem, with n8n as a core platform, enabling faster process transformation, intelligent workflow execution, and measurable gains in productivity, quality, and operational scale.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role responsible for elevating automation standards, reducing manual work and process friction, and enabling AI-powered transformation across the organization.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

This role strengthens Avalara's enterprise automation and transformation capability by establishing scalable, secure, and measurable AI orchestration standards across the organization.

This AI Automation Engineer will:

  • Improve operational efficiency and process quality by engineering resilient AI automation solutions and governed platform standards
  • Accelerate business transformation and reduce cycle time through reusable automation patterns, CI/CD enablement, and standardized development frameworks
  • Enhance employee and customer experience by removing manual bottlenecks, reducing process defects, and increasing AI workflow intelligence
  • Advance Avalara's AI-first execution model by embedding agentic automation, intelligent decisioning, and data-driven observability into enterprise workflows

Bar Raiser Expectations

As a Bar Raiser, this role is expected to elevate the capability and execution rigor of the entire automation and transformation function, not simply contribute as a senior engineer. This includes:

  • Holding high standards for quality, ownership, reliability, and accountability
  • Using metrics (automation adoption, cycle-time reduction, SLAs, SLOs, MTTR, cost per workflow) to guide platform and architectural decisions
  • Simplifying complex business processes into scalable, governed, and maintainable automations
  • Mentoring engineers and contractors to raise automation maturity and talent density
  • Challenging technical assumptions constructively and driving measurable improvement
  • Leaving every platform, process, and engineering practice stronger than it was before

This role does not only build automation, it transforms how work is engineered, automated, governed, and scaled across Avalara.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Enterprise AI Automation Leadership

  • Own the enterprise-wide AI automation and transformation strategy with n8n as a core orchestration platform
  • Architect scalable, secure, and resilient automation solutions that eliminate manual effort, improve process quality, and reduce operational friction
  • Design hybrid patterns leveraging n8n/Boomi, APIs, event-driven systems, and AI agents to improve reuse, enable intelligent decisioning, and reduce time-to-value
  • Define patterns for embedding AI-driven workflows (LLMs, agents, and decision engines) into business processes across functions
  • Lead architecture reviews and drive best-in-class automation design standards, including AI-assisted design patterns and governance

Platform Ownership (n8n)

  • Serve as a technical owner for n8n and AI workflow automation initiatives
  • Define environment strategy (dev/test/prod), CI/CD pipelines, and governance models to reduce deployment risk and increase release velocity
  • Enable AI-powered workflow capabilities within n8n (e.g., agent orchestration, prompt management, model integrations, human-in-the-loop controls)
  • Implement workflow standards, logging, monitoring, and reliability guardrails to improve MTTR, uptime, and automation trust
  • Incorporate AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, and intelligent alerting to proactively detect failures, drift, and degraded workflow performance
  • Ensure platform scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability for both deterministic and AI-driven workflows

Standards & Governance

  • Establish enterprise automation development standards and best practices
  • Define exception-handling frameworks, retry strategies, naming conventions, security protocols, and approval patterns that reduce production defects
  • Create reusable templates, accelerators, and automation design patterns, including AI agent templates and reusable prompt frameworks
  • Define governance for AI usage (model selection, cost controls, prompt/version management, data privacy, and auditability)
  • Introduce code review processes and quality gates that increase execution rigor, including AI workflow validation and evaluation standards

Technical Mentorship & Delivery Excellence

  • Operate as a player-coach — hands-on while mentoring engineers
  • Guide contractor and external implementation teams to ensure quality and standards adherence
  • Lead technical design sessions, workflow reviews, and post-incident reviews
  • Mentor teams on designing, building, and operationalizing AI agents and autonomous workflows within business processes
  • Promote best practices for prompt engineering, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI automation
  • Elevate automation engineering capability across the organization, including AI fluency and adoption

12-Month Success Signals

Within the first 12 months, this role will have:

  • Enabled AI-native automation capabilities, including production-grade AI agents integrated into core workflows
  • Improved automation reliability and reduced workflow failure rates and/or MTTR
  • Standardized automation patterns, including AI-enabled orchestration patterns, adopted across new transformation initiatives
  • Implemented measurable observability, including AI performance, business impact, and cost metrics
  • Delivered AI-driven automation use cases that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, or shorten process cycle time across multiple functions
  • Raised execution standards across the automation team through mentorship, technical leadership, and AI capability development

What You'll Need to be Successful

AI Expectations

As an AI-first company, Avalara expects this role to embed AI into how automation and transformation work is designed and executed.

This role will:

  • Design and implement AI-enabled workflows and transformation patterns that materially improve speed, automation, and scale
  • Use AI tools to optimize development productivity, workflow diagnostics, process analysis, and root-cause investigation
  • Identify high-value AI automation opportunities tied to efficiency, reliability, employee experience, or customer impact
  • Apply AI responsibly with appropriate governance, security, and risk considerations
  • Elevate AI capability across the automation team by sharing best practices and driving measurable adoption

This role must demonstrate applied AI impact — not casual tool usage — and quantify improvements enabled by AI-driven automation and transformation.

What You Bring

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required)
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise automation, workflow engineering, integration engineering, or platform architecture
  • Deep hands-on expertise in n8n or Boomi, including building and orchestrating AI-enabled workflows, agents, and cross-functional business automations
  • Experience designing API-first and event-driven architectures, including integration of AI/ML services and agent-based systems
  • Strong understanding of REST, webhooks, OAuth, JWT, and API security, along with secure integration of AI services and model endpoints
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for automation or integration platforms, including deployment and versioning strategies for AI workflows, prompts, and models
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and scalable model integration patterns
  • Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks, and how they apply to enterprise automation
  • Experience with observability and monitoring, including AI-specific considerations (latency, cost, accuracy, drift)
  • Proven ability to influence architecture and technical direction at scale, including driving adoption of AI-powered automation, process transformation, and intelligent orchestration patterns

Pay Range Details

The base pay range(s) below are provided in compliance with state specific laws. Pay ranges may be different in other locations.

Colorado $126,000-$201,600 (annually)

Washington $126,000-$222,800 (annually)

California $126,000-$244,000 (annually)

NYC $139,200-$244,000 (annually)

The pay range above is the general base pay range for a successful candidate in the state listed. The successful candidate’s actual salary/wage may be based on various factors, such as geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. This role is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, depending on the terms of the applicable plan and the employee’s role.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

Celldex is pioneering new horizons in immunology to deliver life-changing therapies. We are relentless in our pursuit of novel antibody-based treatments that engage the human immune system and directly affect critical pathways to improve the lives of patients with allergic, inflammatory and autoimmune disorders. We have built a culture where innovative and talented people thrive—focusing a significant effort on attracting and retaining passionate and motivated employees who want to play a role in helping people with serious health conditions and who see this effort as personally rewarding. In our highly entrepreneurial environment, employees are empowered and the opportunity for professional development occurs every day.

The US HEOR lead is a critical member of the HEOR team that serves as the US healthcare decision maker voice in the Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation Department. The Senior Director, US HEOR works collaboratively with cross-functional partners including medical affairs, market access, commercial, regulatory and others to align on the value of barzolvolimab and other pipeline products and their place in therapy. The Senior Director serves as a subject matter expert in US payer landscape, PIE, US models and dossiers. The US HEOR lead will work with in-house teams and partner closely with Field Medical, Market Access, and future field-based HEOR capabilities to translate evidence into actionable insights for healthcare decision makers. This role will incorporate field-generated payer, provider, and health system insights into evidence generation and value communication strategies. This position will report to the Executive Director of HEOR.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement US customer facing deliverables (Medical PIE decks, US BIM, AMCP dossier, etc.) for products in the Celldex pipeline to build the foundation for the unmet needs and product value
  • Develop and maintain relationships with external HEOR researchers and establish evidence-based solutions to solve access challenges
  • Provide access expertise for cross functional team members within the broader Medical Affairs & Evidence Generation department
  • Develops US HEOR strategic and tactical plans aligned with Medical Affairs and Market Access leadership; Ensures critical RWE and access insights are communicated and implemented into the strategic plans (ex. Integrated evidence generation plan, payer value proposition)
  • Establish and standardize internal processes and framework for the development of medical payer focused deliverables in partnership with Strategy, Excellence, and Operations function.
  • Partner with Field Medical Leadership, MSL, Field HEOR & Account Management teams to identify evidence gaps, capture healthcare decision making insights and inform evidence generation, value communication and launch readiness strategies
  • Lead enterprise initiatives that solve for access, reimbursement and HTA challenges
  • Effectively present research findings, economic models and payers facing slide decks to internal and external stakeholders
  • Ensure HEOR activities and external engagements are conducted with scientific integrity and in accordance with applicable company policies, industry standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory and compliance expectations.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, SciD, MD) in relevant discipline
  • Minimum 10+ years biopharma experience in health economics, outcomes research, patient reported outcomes, market access or related fields in biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry
  • Proven record of development of payer customer facing tools such as AMCP Dossier, Budget Impact Models and medical PIE decks
  • Experience developing and executing customer research collaborations
  • Deep knowledge and experience in managed care, integrated delivery networks, formulary decision makers, payment/access models and US policy and HTA trends
  • Track record of established relationships and collaborating with end users of HEOR evidence to support healthcare decision makers
  • Ability to view HEOR from both a scientific and business perspective
  • Work effectively cross functionally with strong problem-solving skills
  • Expertise in pharmacoeconomic analysis, patient reported outcomes, observational research and their application to healthcare decision makers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Travel Required – 30-40%

Compensation Statement

The expected base salary for this position is: $203157.00 to $263841.00. We are committed to compensating employees equitably based on several factors including experience, education, licensure/certifications, skill level, location of the position, and availability of similar talent in a competitive market. Subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms, compensation includes base salary, annual discretionary bonus, long term incentive, 401(K) plan with employer contribution, health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), paid holidays, vacation, and sick days. A summary of our benefits can be found on our careers page Celldex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that strives to foster a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to promoting a diverse environment through development, recruiting and community outreach.

raw.excerpt: What You'll Do Avalara is accelerating an AI-first transformation in which agentic systems will change how customers, partners, and employees complete tax compliance work.
raw.description:
What You'll Do

Avalara is accelerating an AI-first transformation in which agentic systems will change how customers, partners, and employees complete tax compliance work. This role exists now to help build and scale the Avalara Avi Agent (AAA), the agentic engineering foundation required for Aviator and future agentic capabilities across Avalara. The person in this role will turn emerging AI patterns into secure, reliable, production-grade systems that increase automation, improve customer outcomes, and enable Avalara teams to build agentic solutions faster and with higher quality.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

As an Agentic and Machine Learning Engineer V, you will raise Avalara's ability to deliver AI-powered products at enterprise scale. Your work will help establish reusable platform capabilities, implementation patterns, evaluation practices, and operational standards for agentic applications. By improving the reliability, accuracy, security, and scalability of these systems, you will enable faster delivery of Aviator and other agentic efforts while reducing duplicated engineering effort across teams. The impact of this role will be visible in stronger customer experiences, more efficient compliance workflows, and a higher bar for AI engineering across Avalara.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Design, build, and operate foundational agentic platform capabilities that enable Aviator, AAA, and other Avalara agentic experiences to move from prototype to production.
  • Develop scalable LLM application frameworks, orchestration patterns, tool integrations, and agent workflows that support enterprise-grade reliability, observability, security, and maintainability.
  • Create and improve evaluation methods for agentic outcomes, including quality, accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task-completion effectiveness.
  • Translate ambiguous business and product needs into technical designs, prototypes, production features, and measurable engineering outcomes.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, code review, documentation, and operational readiness, to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Partner with product, engineering, security, data, and business stakeholders to ensure agentic capabilities solve meaningful customer and operational problems.
  • Research, assess, and responsibly apply emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, model-context protocols, agent-to-agent patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and automation techniques.
  • Document reusable patterns and implementation guidance that help Avalara engineers and software agents build consistently, safely, and efficiently.
  • Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, coaching, and examples of high-ownership execution.
  • Strengthen the operational robustness of mature high-availability systems while introducing new AI capabilities without compromising customer trust or production stability.

12-Month Success Signals

  • Aviator and other priority agentic initiatives are using production-grade platform capabilities owned or significantly shaped by this role.
  • Reusable frameworks, libraries, or service patterns reduce the time required for Avalara teams to build and launch agentic workflows.
  • Agentic systems have measurable evaluation coverage for quality, accuracy, reliability, cost, latency, and safety, with improvement trends visible over time.
  • Critical agentic services meet agreed operational readiness standards, including observability, incident response, testing, documentation, and scalability targets.
  • Stakeholders can point to measurable business or customer impact, such as increased automation, faster workflow completion, improved experience quality, or reduced manual effort.
  • The engineer has raised team capability through mentoring, clear technical direction, stronger code/design review practices, and documented patterns that others reuse.

AI Expectations

Avalara is an AI-first company. This role must demonstrate applied AI capability, not casual tool usage. The person in this role is expected to embed AI into how engineering work gets done and to help others do the same responsibly.

  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering speed, design exploration, testing, code quality, documentation, debugging, operational analysis, and knowledge reuse.
  • Identify AI opportunities tied to measurable outcomes such as customer experience, workflow automation, developer productivity, reliability, cost efficiency, and risk reduction.
  • Apply AI responsibly, securely, and ethically, including attention to data handling, governance, evaluation, auditability, and failure modes.
  • Bring evidence to AI decisions, including impact metrics, tradeoff analysis, and clear reasoning for tool, model, protocol, or architecture choices.
  • Share AI practices, prompts, evaluation methods, implementation patterns, and lessons learned to raise the AI capability of peers and partner teams.

Bar Raiser Expectations

This role is expected to raise the average performance of the team by improving technical judgment, execution quality, accountability, and business impact. The successful candidate will hold themselves and others to high standards, simplify complexity, challenge assumptions respectfully, use data in decision-making, and leave systems, processes, and teams stronger than they found them.

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience building, deploying, and operating production software systems, with strong preference for Python experience.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, agentic systems, or AI-enabled workflows in production or production-like environments.
  • Experience with LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Llama, or similar models, including practical understanding of prompting, orchestration, evaluation, and reliability considerations.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale software design, distributed systems, data structures, design patterns, and high-availability system operations.
  • Experience working in cloud computing environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Applied familiarity with modern agentic integration patterns and protocols, such as MCP, A2A, tool use, retrieval, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve measurable outcomes, such as speed, quality, automation, insight, customer experience, or scale.
  • Strong communication, documentation, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
