Basic Qualifications

Education requirements:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience is required plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

Clearance Requirements:Department of Defense TS/SCI security clearance obtainable within reasonable time based on requirements. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Overview:A Contracts Specialist is responsible for supporting the management of the company's contractual agreements with customers, in the drafting, negotiation, and execution of contracts, as well as ensuring compliance with contract terms and conditions. The Contracts Specialist also maintains accurate contract records and databases and assists in identifying and mitigating any contract-related risks. Additionally, this role requires strong communication and organizational skills, as the Contracts Specialist will work closely with program managers, legal teams, and customers to ensure that all contractual obligations are met.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as focal point for all contractual communications and commitments to customers or subcontractors.
  • Advises and supports business team on issues/developments relative to assigned contracts or subcontracts.
  • Negotiates contracts or subcontracts within business goals and documents substance of discussions, agreements, and results.
  • Participates as a key member of the proposal or program team to address contract or subcontract requirements.
  • Monitors contract or subcontract performance for scope changes and takes appropriate action.
  • Manages contract or subcontract change process and collaborates with the Program Manager, including Pro-gram Manager - Subcontracts, Engineering, Finance, and other disciplines to mitigate performance risk.
  • Monitors program performance for scope changes and takes appropriate action.
  • Provides domain expertise in contract or subcontract management.
  • Provides leadership, subject matter expertise, and innovative recommendations to new or unusual contracting, subcontracting, or programmatic issues.
  • Executes engagements with customers or subcontractors consistent with policies.
  • Supports an overall understanding of the Contracts Department operations and GDMS enterprise objectives.
  • Reviews or supports reviews of subcontractor proposals, including management of the source selection process by participating with the proposal evaluation team in fact-finding, technical evaluation, and cost or price analysis.
  • Builds customer or subcontractor relationships and knows customer or subcontractor needs and issues.
  • Collaborates with the Capture/Proposal/Program Manager, including Program Manager - Subcontracts, to support overall contract or subcontract performance, which may include preparing subcontractor Request for Proposal documentation.
  • Participates as a key member of the proposal or program team to address contract and/or subcontract requirements.
  • Mentors and supports junior contracts team members by providing guidance, sharing best practices, and offering advice on complex contractual issues to enhance their professional development and improve overall team performance

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Excellent knowledge of applicable federal regulations (FAR/DFARS) and experience with prime contractors or subcontractors across various contract types.
  • Possesses excellent experience reviewing and analyzing contract or subcontract documents for accuracy, performance risk, and conformance with contract terms, conditions, and other provisions.
  • Excellent understanding of contract or subcontract management principles.
  • Excellent analytical/critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Excellent negotiation skills for contracts or subcontracts of moderate to high risk/complexity.
  • Demonstrates flexibility and the ability to prioritize/re-prioritize with changing goals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deal effectively with personnel at all levels.
  • Excellent computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Office) to support effective communications and business needs.
  • Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways, demonstrating innovative approaches and solutions.
  • Collaborates and works effectively cross-functionally throughout the business.
  • Demonstrates judgment and creativity to identify and resolve moderately complex contract or subcontract is-sues, recognizing when more expert guidance is required.
  • Possesses a growth mindset for continuous learning to remain current with regulations and internal procedure.
  • Shows initiative on assignments, exercises independent judgment, and professionally executes projects with little direction.
  • Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.
  • Very strong in grasping and applying new information quickly and handling complex assignments.
  • Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise and senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise.
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $131,319.00 - USD $142,091.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

The Manager, Technical Assistance Center is responsible for ensuring that the Technical Assistance Center (TAC) provides the highest level of support to our customers by building team unity and spirit, reinforcing the importance of schedule, strong work ethics, and customer focus; establishing standard performance metrics, schedules, and milestones; reliably executing on commitments; evaluating team and individual performance.

To meet the needs of our customers, working outside normal business hours and holidays is required.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Maintains a customer-focused organization which exceeds customer expectations.
  • Manages multiple conflicting customer needs, including planned activities and unplanned emergencies.
  • Establishes and owns positive customer relationship post installation for designated high-visibility customers.
  • Acts as escalation point for issue resolution. Provides leadership and collaboration to multi-disciplinary team for management of customer issues to full resolution.
  • Schedules all work assigned to the department and assigns TAC personnel to the appropriate shifts to provide optimum coverage to our customers.
  • Oversees and guides the work of the TAC personnel; maintains the quality and timeliness of work performed by the TAC; handles entire team member hiring process,
  • Provides guidance, oversight, and mentoring of team resources.

  • Evaluates performance of team personnel and assigns training to team members in line with developmental goals.
  • Evaluates and improves TAC processes and tools.

  • Handles various projects and tasks that may be requested by management.
  • Maintains a travel schedule that is consistent with the requirements of the position.
  • Develops detailed knowledge of the Company's quality management systems, policies and procedures and FDA compliance requirements and ensures that all TAC personnel strictly adhere to all applicable regulations.
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

Baseline Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry related work experience
  • 3+ years Medical Imaging industry experience.
  • Business analysis and creative problem solving.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and make sound decisions while engaged in a challenging situation.
  • Self-directed with excellent management skills (hire/fire, mentoring, conflict resolution, reviews, salary administration, etc.)
  • Strong interpersonal, team building and leadership skills.
  • Resourceful and thorough with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Proven ability to motivate, lead and direct personnel in a matrix work environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of the Synapse product line
  • Knowledge of Windows OS (Microsoft Server 2008, 2012, 2016+), networking, SQL Server and Oracle
  • Understanding of DICOM, HL7, SQL, networking, server, and other applicable technologies.
  • Knowledge of distributed datacenter Security from a remote support perspective (security certifications are highly desirable)

In addition to the above, all employees are expected to:

  • Help train and give guidance to peers/employees.
  • Provide customers with the highest quality products and services.
  • Understand and apply appropriate quality management system processes.
  • Promote Company standards of business conduct.

Physical Requirements:

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.

raw.title: Support Tax Technologist
raw.excerpt: What You’ll Do Role Summary The Support Tax Technologist serves as the strategic bridge between Avalara’s product vision and the real-world needs of enterprise customers.
raw.description:
What You’ll Do

Role Summary

The Support Tax Technologist serves as the strategic bridge between Avalara’s product vision and the real-world needs of enterprise customers. This role combines deep tax technology expertise, enterprise ERP integration knowledge, and advanced troubleshooting capabilities to help customers maximize the value of Avalara solutions.

The Support Tax Technologist works closely with large enterprise customers to understand complex business requirements, uncover real-world use cases, and translate tax and compliance requirements into scalable, integrated solutions. Acting as both a technical advisor and domain expert, this role provides expert guidance on Avalara’s platform, enterprise integrations, and compliance automation capabilities while bringing field insights back to Product, Engineering teams to influence solution development and improve customer outcomes.

The role also plays a critical part in post-implementation customer success by partnering closely with the Implementation Tax Technologist team during hypercare and customer handoff, ensuring continuity, adoption, and long-term operational success.

How This Role Elevates Avalara

From a business perspective, the Support Tax Technologist strengthens Avalara’s relationships with large enterprise customers by helping them design, deploy, and optimize scalable compliance solutions embedded within their operational systems. Through deep technical and tax expertise, this role improves customer retention, supports expansion opportunities, and increases confidence in Avalara’s ability to solve complex compliance challenges.

For our teams, the Support Tax Technologist serves as a key conduit between customers, partners, Product, Engineering, and Support teams. By surfacing customer insights, identifying recurring integration and configuration challenges, and providing structured feedback, this role helps shape product enhancements, improve support readiness, and reduce operational friction. The role also drives internal enablement through coaching, office hours, knowledge sharing, and training programs that elevate the capabilities of customer-facing teams.

For customers, the Support Tax Technologist acts as a trusted advisor who combines tax domain expertise with technical integration knowledge. By helping customers automate, scale, and de-risk compliance processes, this role enables organizations to move beyond periodic tax filing activities toward continuous, embedded compliance across their ERP, eCommerce, billing, and financial systems.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Responsibilities

  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and partners through the support case process to assist with integration challenges and compliance automation objectives.
  • Provide subject matter expertise for Avalara solutions and integrations.
  • Translate tax requirements, including sales and use tax, VAT, exemptions, returns, e-invoicing, and other compliance obligations into configurable and scalable technology solutions.
  • Deliver expert support for Avalara enterprise ERP integrations and associated business workflows.
  • Handle escalated customer issues and critical support situations, leading root cause analysis, coordinating internal stakeholders, and ensuring timely resolution.
  • Collaborate with customers to understand technical challenges, identify root causes, and implement comprehensive long-term solutions.
  • Design and recommend scalable compliance architectures that enable customers to embed compliance into their operational systems rather than relying on manual tax processes.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams by delivering structured customer feedback and insights that influence product direction and solution development.
  • Support post-implementation hypercare activities and work closely with the Implementation Tax Technologist team to ensure seamless handoff and long-term customer success.
  • Lead customer-facing training programs, webinars, and enablement sessions for enterprise customers and strategic partners.
  • Drive internal enablement by evaluating recurring customer questions and conducting weekly office hours sessions for Global Support Organization (GSO) teams.
  • Develop and maintain best practices, technical documentation, integration guidance, and knowledge resources that improve organizational effectiveness.

12-month Success Signals

  • Demonstrable expertise in at least one enterprise ERP platform and serves as a recognized internal subject matter expert.
  • Reduces recurring support issues by identifying systemic integration, configuration, and process challenges and driving long-term solutions.
  • Successfully supports seamless post-implementation transitions and hypercare engagements for enterprise customers, resulting in improved adoption and customer satisfaction.
  • Delivers measurable improvements in customer adoption, platform utilization, and operational compliance outcomes.
  • Influences multiple product enhancements or process improvements through structured feedback gathered from customer and partner interactions.
  • Successfully conducts customer webinars, training sessions, and enablement programs that increase customer knowledge and self-service capabilities.
  • Establishes highly utilized internal office hours and coaching programs that improve support readiness and technical proficiency in ERP integration best practices.
  • Contributes to scalable compliance strategies that help customers move from traditional tax filing activities to embedded, automated compliance operations.

What You'll Need to be Successful

AI Expectations

Avalara is an AI-first company.

We expect every employee, manager, and leader to actively leverage AI to enhance productivity, quality, innovation, and customer value. AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products — and success at Avalara requires embracing AI as an essential capability, not an optional tool.

AI Bar Raiser Expectations

A successful Support Tax Technologist will:

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI capabilities within enterprise ERP systems, and recommend innovative applications that improve customer outcomes and organizational effectiveness.
  • Demonstrate advanced, applied AI expertise to improve customer diagnostics, technical analysis, integration troubleshooting, and compliance solution recommendations.
  • Leverage AI to accelerate root cause analysis, customer issue resolution, and knowledge creation while maintaining accuracy and compliance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI to improve customer enablement, training delivery, technical documentation, and operational efficiency.
  • Quantify AI-driven outcomes through measurable improvements in resolution speed, knowledge reuse, automation, customer satisfaction, and support effectiveness.
  • Share AI best practices and coach peers on effective AI adoption within technical support and customer-facing workflows.
  • Drive responsible AI usage while ensuring customer data security, compliance, and governance requirements are maintained.

We are looking for a Support Tax Technologist to raise the bar for Avalara and our customers through:

  • Elevating team capability and customer outcomes through technical leadership, knowledge sharing, coaching, and practical guidance on enterprise integrations, compliance automation, and support best practices.
  • Demonstrating strong ownership and accountability for complex, high-impact customer issues, especially in escalated and cross-functional situations, and modeling calm, thorough, end-to-end resolution leadership.
  • Improving systems, processes, and documentation so enterprise support motions become more scalable, consistent, and effective over time.
  • Simplifying complex tax, compliance, and technical integration challenges into actionable guidance that improves internal execution and helps customers operate with greater confidence.
  • Challenging assumptions constructively and identifying better approaches that reduce friction, strengthen support readiness, and improve long-term customer success.
  • Leaving every customer engagement, internal partnership, and operational process stronger than they found it by contributing insights, enablement, and durable improvements that increase organizational effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in tax technology implementation, enterprise application support, ERP integrations, technical consulting, or technical support within the compliance automation industry.
    • Experience supporting large enterprise customers and complex technical environments.
    • Experience working with enterprise ERP systems, with subject matter expertise in at least one major ERP platform.
    • Experience supporting cloud-based business applications and SaaS platforms.
    • Experience with tax and compliance technology solutions, including sales and use tax, VAT, exemptions, returns, and related compliance processes.

For a small business owner, getting set up for sales or lodging tax can be the most stressful part of using our product — and the moment they decide whether to trust us. As Head of Operations, you'll own onboarding, go-live and customer support for a portfolio that includes DAVO (automated sales tax for small businesses, set up through their point-of-sale system) and MyLodgeTax (lodging tax registration and filing for short-term rental hosts), along with the registration operations that get customers compliant in the first place.

This isn't a role about growing a support team in line with customer growth. It's about building an operation where most customers never need to contact us — because onboarding just works, problems are caught early, and the manual work is automated away. You'll lead the teams that serve customers today and work directly with Product and Engineering to make each of those teams more scalable every quarter.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Own the customer's first 90 days. Lead onboarding and go-live for every customer, from signup to their first successful filing. Define what a great activation looks like, measure it, and remove the friction that slows customers down or sends them to support.

Set service standards, staffing models and quality measures, and treat every recurring contact as a problem to eliminate rather than a ticket to close.

Automate registration operations. Lead the team that handles tax registrations for MyLodgeTax customers today, and partner with Product and Engineering to automate that work, so the team can focus on the exceptions that really need a person.

Turn customer friction into product fixes. Build the feedback loop between operations and the product team: which issues drive contacts, which onboarding steps lose customers, and which fixes would pay back fastest. Bring data, not anecdotes, to roadmap conversations.

Work across Avalara's shared services. Partner with Avalara's filing, payments and notices teams, which this business relies on rather than rebuilding, so the customer experience is seamless end to end.

raw.description:
What You'll Do

We are looking for a Software Architect (I6) to define, evolve, and drive the next-generation architecture for Avalara Tax Research (ATR)—Avalara’s premier, AI-centric self-service tax research platform providing rules, rates, taxability insights, and AI-assisted research experiences across Indirect Tax, Direct Tax, and Trade.

ATR operates at the intersection of high-scale cloud services, information-dense domain content, and cutting-edge generative AI workflows. In this domain, precision is paramount: tax research demands authoritative, citation-backed accuracy where hallucination is unacceptable.

As a Software Architect, you will shape how ATR scales across microservices, data pipelines, domain knowledge graphs, and multi-agent AI architectures. You will be hands-on with reference implementations and proof-of-concepts while exercising high-order communication and influence—collaborating across engineering pods, negotiating API contracts and integration protocols with cross-functional platform teams, and establishing pragmatic architecture roadmaps.

How This Role Elevates Avalara:

Team:

  • Establishes robust platform patterns, domain-driven service boundaries, and clear technical direction across multiple engineering squads.

  • Raises the engineering bar through hands-on reference designs, rigorous architecture reviews, and mentorship of Staff engineers and Tech Leads.

  • Reduces accidental complexity and technical debt by standardizing microservice design, event-driven interfaces, and AI orchestration protocols.

Business:

  • Accelerates time-to-market for premier AI capabilities across Indirect, Direct, and Trade tax domains without compromising reliability, compliance, or cost efficiency.

  • Strengthens Avalara’s competitive moat by transforming vast, complex tax repositories into high-confidence, programmatic APIs and agentic research workflows.

Customer:

  • Delivers rapid, resilient, and citation-backed research experiences that tax professionals and automated systems can trust implicitly.

  • Translates advanced AI and retrieval architectures into verifiable, audit-proof answers with transparent provenance and sub-second performance.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Architecture & Microservices Strategy

  • Own and evolve the target-state architecture for ATR across microservices, data ingestion, search/retrieval, and AI agent layers.

  • Architect high-throughput, low-latency, resilient distributed microservices utilizing modern cloud-native stacks (Go, PostgreSQL, vector stores, distributed streaming, and event-driven messaging).

  • Define clean service boundaries, gRPC/REST APIs, asynchronous workflows, and integration protocols across disparate domain subsystems.

AI-Native, Multi-Agent & Grounded Retrieval Systems

  • Lead the architecture for ATR’s AI-native capabilities, including advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, semantic routing, and citation attribution pipelines designed for information-dense content.

  • Integrate continuous AI evaluation, observability, and guardrail frameworks (e.g., Arize or equivalent LLM eval platforms) to measure, benchmark, and systematically improve answer quality, grounding fidelity, and latency.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Technical Influence

  • Serve as the technical authority and primary architecture liaison across engineering pods, product management, security, SRE, and adjacent platform teams.

  • Negotiate integration protocols, contract schemas, and shared infrastructure boundaries with clarity and pragmatic engineering judgment.

  • Translate business strategy into phased architectural blueprints, RFCs, and delivery milestones aligned with organizational operating models (AIM30).

Hands-On Technical Leadership & Governance

  • Build proof-of-concepts (PoCs), reference implementations, and scaffolding for novel agentic workflows, caching strategies, and data access layers.

  • Partner with tax content engineering stakeholders to design ingestion and normalization pipelines for highly structured and unstructured legal/tax datasets.

  • Champion non-functional requirements (NFRs): multi-tenancy isolation, secrets management, role-based access control (RBAC), operational observability, disaster recovery, and cost-to-serve optimization.

 

12-Month Success Signals:

  • Verifiable Accuracy & Grounding: Citation fidelity and answer grounding metrics reach industry-leading accuracy benchmarks with automated evaluation pipelines actively catching regressions.

  • Architectural Cohesion: Service boundaries and API contracts across ATR’s core microservices and domain-specific agents are clearly defined, reducing cross-team delivery dependencies.

  • Multi-Agent & Workflow Maturity: A scalable multi-agent and workflow orchestration framework is established in production, enabling multi-turn research and tool-calling capabilities.

  • Engineering Velocity: Reusable service templates, reference implementations, and standardized evaluation patterns measurably reduce the onboarding and feature delivery time for engineering pods.

  • Operational Rigor: System reliability, P99 latency, and cost-per-query targets meet or exceed established SLA/SLO thresholds under growing enterprise workloads.

AI Expectations:

Avalara is an AI-first company, and ATR is a flagship AI product. Every senior technical leader is expected to demonstrate role-relevant AI leadership:

  • Architecting for Accuracy: Designing retrieval and agent architectures that prioritize grounding, transparency, and provenance over unvalidated generation.

  • Systematic Evaluation: Leveraging automated evals and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to optimize prompts, context windows, chunking strategies, and model selection.

  • Engineering Productivity: Championing agentic development tools and AI-assisted workflows within engineering teams to accelerate code quality, testing, and architecture exploration.

  • Safety & Responsible AI: Implementing robust guardrails for prompt injection defense, data privacy, tenant isolation, and auditability.

What You'll Need to be Successful:

  • Leadership Level: Proven track record as a Staff+ Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Software Architect (I6 equivalent) driving architecture for enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

  • Distributed Microservices Mastery: Deep, hands-on expertise designing, building, and deploying microservices architectures in production using modern back-end languages (e.g., Go, Java, or C#) and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).

  • Applied AI & Information-Dense Retrieval: Demonstrated experience building production-grade RAG and AI applications over dense, authoritative content domains. Strong understanding of embeddings, vector databases, hybrid lexical/semantic search, and chunking/re-ranking strategies.

  • Evaluation & Quality Benchmarking: Hands-on familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (e.g., Arize, Ragas, Phoenix, TruLens, or LangSmith) to benchmark hallucination rates, retrieval precision, and answer relevance.

  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: High-order verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to author crisp architectural design records (ADRs/RFCs), align diverse stakeholders, and negotiate cross-team technical contracts.

  • Security & Cloud Resiliency: Thorough understanding of cloud-native design, container orchestration (Kubernetes), API gateways/service mesh, zero-trust security, and observability (metrics, tracing, structured logs).

Preferred/Nice-to-Have

  • Experience architecting multi-agent systems, agent coordination protocols, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or graph-based workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines).

  • Experience with domain-driven design for complex metadata, knowledge graphs, or regulatory/compliance document repositories.

Bar Raiser Expectations:

  • Background in high-pressure, emotionally charged settings, working with vulnerable individuals.

  • Excellent communication skills, adaptable to various audiences.

The Vice President of Finance – Critical Infrastructure will serve as a strategic finance partner and key member of the segment leadership team, supporting a group of 3–4 business units with approximately $300–400 million in combined annual revenue.

Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this individual will partner closely with Regional Vice Presidents and business unit leadership to drive financial performance, improve profitability and support strategic business decisions. This role goes beyond traditional financial reporting, requiring a leader who can translate financial results into actionable business insights and identify opportunities to improve margins, productivity and working capital.

The VP of Finance will lead and develop a team of Business Unit Controllers and their respective finance teams, ensuring strong financial controls, accurate reporting and consistent financial processes across the segment.

This is a highly visible leadership position requiring a balance of strong technical accounting knowledge, financial planning and analysis, operational partnership and people leadership. The ideal candidate is comfortable challenging business leaders, understanding the details behind financial performance and helping drive long-term business growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a strategic financial partner to Regional Vice Presidents and business unit leadership, supporting business planning, budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial strategy.
  • Lead, mentor and develop 3–4 Business Unit Controllers and their respective finance teams, building a high-performing organization focused on accountability, analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Analyze financial and operational results to identify trends, risks and opportunities before they impact business performance.
  • Partner with operational leaders to identify and implement EBITDA improvement initiatives, including margin enhancement, pricing strategies, labor productivity, vendor management and working capital improvements.
  • Oversee financial forecasting and reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely financial information is delivered to executive leadership.
  • Lead monthly financial and business performance reviews, providing insight into financial results, operational trends and recommended actions.
  • Develop and monitor key financial and operational performance indicators to support better decision-making across the business units.
  • Challenge financial assumptions, forecasts and business plans through detailed analysis and collaboration with operational leadership.
  • Oversee monthly close processes, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and financial controls across the segment.
  • Ensure consistent application of accounting policies and procedures, including percentage-of-completion (POC) accounting and revenue recognition requirements.
  • Support mergers and acquisitions, including financial due diligence, integration activities and post-acquisition performance reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize financial processes, improve reporting capabilities and establish best practices across business units.
  • Provide financial guidance and support for pricing decisions, business development opportunities, capital investments and other strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with corporate finance, accounting, FP&A and other executive leadership teams.
  • Conduct regular site visits to business units and field locations to develop a strong understanding of operations and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Support annual audits, compliance requirements and other financial or operational initiatives as needed.

Requirements and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field required.
  • CPA and/or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including leadership responsibility within a complex business environment.
  • Experience leading Controllers, accounting leaders or finance teams across multiple business units or locations.
  • Strong understanding of percentage-of-completion (POC) accounting, project-based financial operations and revenue recognition.
  • Experience with financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling and variance analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with operational leaders and influence business decisions through financial analysis and reporting.
  • Experience identifying and implementing initiatives to improve profitability, EBITDA, margins and working capital.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, accounting policies and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed, multi-entity, construction, infrastructure or project-based services environment strongly preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience developing financial dashboards, KPIs and management reporting.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to develop teams, delegate effectively and drive accountability.
  • Excellent analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex financial information to both financial and non-financial audiences.
  • Ability to travel regularly to business unit and field locations, including quarterly visits and additional travel as business needs require.

Do you want to help design and implement the next generation of cloud networking?

Do you want to dive deep into the inner workings of Virtual Private Clouds, dynamic tunneling and overlay routing?

Join our Routing Services team!

Akamai Cloud is the world's most distributed cloud platform. Our customers range from frontier AI companies to established market leaders. We own the host routing software stack, overlay network and the networking configurations that enable our customers to run massive computing workloads in our Cloud data centers.

Partner with the best

We are seeking an experienced data center network architect with a foundation in Linux systems and coding. You will serve as the crucial bridge between software engineering and network operations. You will balance the vast possibilities of software development with the strict demands of network reliability, maintainability, and operational realism.

As an Architect Senior, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring that software-driven network designs remain practical, highly reliable, and operationally sound in a massive-scale data center environment.
  • Defining the technical roadmap and architecture for large-scale data center overlay routing, tunneling, and multi-tenant VPC networking.
  • Architecting solutions for hitless control-plane restarts, sub-second failovers, graceful restart/BGP route-server topologies, and fault-isolation domains to ensure zero downtime during protocol state churn.
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Author high-impact Architecture and Design proposals; align with engineering SRE, Network Automation, and Product Management teams.
  • Working closely with peers, and coordinating with teams globally as part of designing new features, dealing with bugs or driving consensus on a technical solution.
  • Leading technical design reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers across software and network disciplines.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Bring experience architecting and operating commercial data center environments, (how network operators think and the realities of production networks).
  • Understand deeply the Linux kernel networking subsystem (Netlink sockets, network namespaces, FIB/routing tables, connection tracking, and packet flow lifecycles).
  • Excel in Modern DC Overlays and EVPN: Possess deep, practical knowledge of BGP EVPN and VXLAN.
  • Maintain sharp programming skills in systems languages (e.g., Go, C, or C++) for building proof-of-concepts, reviewing daemon source code, designing custom route-server or policy controllers,

raw.description:
Senior FDA Compliance Analyst

Reports to: Head of Third Party Services

Position Summary

The Senior FDA Compliance Analyst supports FDA regulatory compliance across the organization's multi-site fertility network. Reporting to the Head of Third Party Services, this position serves as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements related to third party reproduction and supports the development, implementation, and monitoring of consistent regulatory processes.

The Analyst plays a key role in transitioning the organization toward a centralized FDA compliance model, with a focus on regulatory oversight, policy development, staff education, auditing, inspection readiness, and new practice integration.

Core Responsibilities

FDA Regulatory Compliance

  • Serve as a subject matter resource for FDA requirements applicable to third party reproduction.
  • Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and communicate updates to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide guidance on donor eligibility, screening, testing, documentation, quarantine, release, and recordkeeping.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external regulatory partners to address compliance questions and concerns.

Program Development & Standardization

  • Support the development and implementation of a centralized FDA compliance model across the network.
  • Assess existing workflows, identify regulatory and operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain standardized policies, consents, SOPs, work instructions, and documentation requirements.
  • Support consistent application of FDA requirements while accounting for appropriate practice-level differences.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize technology, workflows, and centralized support processes.

Auditing & Compliance Monitoring

  • Support the development and execution of an internal FDA audit program.
  • Conduct routine and targeted audits to identify compliance gaps, documentation deficiencies, and operational risks.
  • Prepare audit findings and recommendations and assist with corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Track corrective actions through resolution and monitor recurring issues.
  • Maintain compliance metrics and provide regular updates to the Head of Third Party Services.

FDA Inspection Readiness

  • Support ongoing FDA inspection readiness across applicable practices.
  • Conduct readiness assessments, mock inspections, and documentation reviews.
  • Serve as a key resource during FDA inspections, coordinating documentation, communication, and follow-up activities.
  • Assist with responses to regulatory observations and corrective actions.
  • Maintain inspection records and share lessons learned across the network.

Education & Training

  • Develop and deliver standardized FDA compliance education and training.
  • Support onboarding, ongoing education, and competency development for staff involved in FDA-regulated activities.
  • Provide targeted education in response to regulatory changes, audit findings, and identified knowledge gaps.
  • Serve as an ongoing resource for staff questions related to FDA requirements.

Integration & New Practice Support

  • Participate in FDA compliance assessments during acquisition due diligence and support transition planning for newly integrated practices.
  • Support FDA compliance assessments for new practice acquisitions and integrations.
  • Review current-state workflows, policies, documentation, and systems to identify gaps.
  • Assist with transition plans to align new practices with the organization's centralized FDA compliance model.
  • Coordinate implementation of required workflows, SOPs, tools, and training.
  • Provide go-live and post-implementation support and monitor adoption.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in regulatory affairs, life sciences, healthcare administration, quality management, business administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Experience in FDA-regulated reproductive medicine, tissue banking, third party reproduction, or a comparable regulatory environment.
  • Knowledge of FDA requirements related to reproductive tissue and donor eligibility.
  • Experience developing and maintaining regulatory policies, SOPs, and workflows.
  • Experience conducting compliance audits, supporting regulatory inspections, and tracking corrective actions.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical operational processes.
  • Ability to independently prioritize work, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and exercise sound judgment when evaluating regulatory and operational risks.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple practices and departments.

Preferred

  • Experience with donor egg, donor sperm, embryo donation, gestational carrier, or other third party reproductive services.
  • Experience supporting FDA compliance across a multi-site healthcare organization.
  • Experience with centralized compliance programs, practice integrations, and regulatory process improvement.
  • Experience developing compliance education and supporting FDA inspections.

This role is open to applicants living in the Philippines.

Operations Assistant VA

Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse

Why This Role Matters
Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running.

What You'll Do
• Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval.
• Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed.
• Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list.
• Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication.
• Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company.
• Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery.
• Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned.

Problems You Will Solve
• Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way.
• Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover.
• Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework.
• Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border.
• Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time.

How Success is Measured
• Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month
• Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline
• Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment
• Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery

Why You'll Love It Here
At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up.

Who You Are
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required)
• Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required)
• Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)
• Comfortable with international shipping basics: freight, tariffs, customs declarations, and product classifications
• Strong written English and the persistence to keep vendors responsive across time zones
• Highly organized with a process-driven mindset and commitment to follow-through

Bonus points if you have:

  • Background in the life sciences, biotechnology, or laboratory supplies industry
    • Experience importing from overseas suppliers, including container consolidation and vendor communication on WeChat

About Filtrous
Founded in 2017, Filtrous delivers speed, quality, and value to agile labs. We're a lab supplies distributor serving laboratories across a wide range of scientific and industrial sectors. Our secret? We combine uncompromising product quality with customer service that actually picks up the phone.

Position Details

Compensation $4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour

Job Type Part-time (20 hours per week)

Location Remote
Schedule Monday to Friday, 3:00–7:00 PM PST (7:00–11:00 AM Philippine Time, Tuesday to Saturday)

Ready to Join Us?
If you love keeping complex orders on track, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help shape how a growing company buys and ships, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
About Rosenblum Law and why this role exists

Rosenblum Law is a growth-focused consumer law firm with three practices: Estate Planning, Traffic Tickets (TrafficTickets.com), and Personal Injury. Our growth runs on technology: lead capture, call tracking, SMS and email nurture, paid acquisition, payments, and the project systems that keep cases moving.

That stack has grown tool by tool, with no single owner. Configuration lives in people's heads, integrations are stitched together with Zapier, and fixes happen reactively. We are hiring our first dedicated technology leader to own how our systems work and connect, make them reliable and documented, and turn them into a competitive advantage.

Role summary

Title

Head of Technology & Systems

Reports to

Chief Operating Officer

Works closely with

CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Managing Attorney, practice leads, sales and intake

Team

Individual contributor at start; may build a small team or manage contractors as the roadmap grows

Location: Remote

Type

Full-time

You will own how technology works and connects at the firm: the integrations, data flows, and architecture across every platform. Marketing platforms are run day to day by the growth team, and you'll support their maintenance and technical health. Half your time is hands-on: building automations, fixing integrations, configuring platforms, and supporting users. The other half is strategic: setting the architecture, choosing and retiring vendors, owning data and security, and building a roadmap leadership can fund and track.

The environment you'll own

You inherit a modern SaaS stack of roughly 15 platforms, with no on-premise infrastructure to speak of. The work is integration, data, automation, and governance.

Category

Platforms

What they do for us

CRM

FileMaker Pro

The firm's CRM: client and matter records, the system of record for client data

Marketing automation & lead nurture

ActiveCampaign, Loops

Email and automation journeys, lead and deal pipelines

Shared intake & communications

CallTrackingMetrics, Sakari

Call tracking and attribution, routing, queues, transcription, two-way texting

Acquisition & SEO

Meta Ads, firm websites incl. TrafficTickets.com

Paid social, search visibility, landing pages and lead forms

Work management

ClickUp

PMO, practice workflows, capacity planning

Collaboration

Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs), Slack

Email, files, scheduling, internal communication

Payments & finance

Stripe, ACH payment workflows

Client payments; ACH validation and bank verification improvements in flight

Workforce

Hubstaff; payroll and contractor platforms (Gusto, Payoneer under review)

Time tracking, payroll, international contractor payments

Automation & AI

Zapier, Claude, AI dictation tools

Cross-system workflows, AI-assisted work

Who owns what: FileMaker Pro is the firm's CRM, and you will own it outright, including its configuration, data quality, and integrations. CallTrackingMetrics and Sakari are shared intake and communications systems used by marketing, sales, and intake, and you will own them outright. The marketing platforms (ActiveCampaign, Loops, Meta Ads, and the firm websites) are owned day to day by the growth team; you own their integrations and support their maintenance. You own all other platforms.

Known work already on the table: the CRM migration project; documenting the ActiveCampaign, CallTrackingMetrics, and Sakari configuration and integrations; restructuring the ClickUp workspace; fixing recurring ACH bounces with a validated payment form and bank verification; and evaluating contractor payment platforms.

Key responsibilities

Strategy and architecture

  • Own the firm's technology roadmap, tied to business goals for each practice, and report progress to leadership.
  • Define a target architecture: which system is the source of truth for leads, clients, matters, payments, and people, and how data flows between them.
  • Run vendor selection, contracts, renewals, and consolidation. Stay vendor-agnostic until requirements are clear, and retire tools that overlap.
  • Own the technology budget and track license spend against usage.
  • Set and enforce standards for security, access, data retention, and client confidentiality appropriate to a law firm.

Hands-on build and optimization

  • Administer and configure the firm's core operating systems: FileMaker Pro (CRM), CallTrackingMetrics and Sakari (shared intake and communications), ClickUp, Google Workspace, Slack, and Stripe.
  • Own the integrations between the marketing platforms (ActiveCampaign, Loops, Meta Ads, and the firm websites) and the firm's other systems, and support the growth team with platform maintenance: access, updates, troubleshooting, and vendor issues.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations and automations (Zapier today; APIs and webhooks where they are more robust).
  • Own the integrations behind lead-to-client flow (forms to the FileMaker Pro CRM and ActiveCampaign, call and SMS data, routing, and handoff from intake to the practice teams), and partner with the growth team on nurture sequences and speed-to-lead.
  • Build reliable attribution so marketing spend in Meta and search ties to calls, signed clients, and revenue.
  • Ship payment and billing improvements, starting with ACH validation and bank verification.
  • Find practical uses for AI across intake, marketing, and operations, with guardrails.

Operations, support, and governance

  • Be the escalation point for system issues. Triage, fix, and find root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Own user lifecycle: onboarding and offboarding, accounts, permissions, and device setup.
  • Document every system's configuration, integrations, and owners, and keep that documentation current.
  • Monitor integrations and data quality; catch broken automations before clients or staff do.
  • Train staff and write simple how-to guides so the firm uses the tools it pays for.

Your first year

1. First 30 days: learn and stabilize. Meet every team, inventory every system, login, integration, and contract. Fix the top three pain points staff raise. Take over admin access for core platforms, and integration access for marketing platforms.

2. Days 31–60: document and decide. Finish documentation of each core system's configuration and integrations (starting with ActiveCampaign, CallTrackingMetrics, and Sakari). Deliver a current-state architecture map, a risk list, and a prioritized backlog.

3. Days 61–90: roadmap and first wins. Present a 12-month technology roadmap and budget to leadership. Ship two to three visible improvements, such as the ACH payment form or a speed-to-lead fix.

4. Months 4–12: build the platform. Deliver the roadmap: consolidated tools, reliable lead-to-revenue reporting, monitored integrations, security baseline in place, and staff trained on the systems they use.

Qualifications

Required

  • AI-first mindset (we are an AI-first organization). Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot to automate work, build workflows, and change how teams operate, with a track record of rolling them out with practical guardrails. You will lead how the firm uses AI across every practice.
  • 7+ years in business systems, IT, or marketing/revenue operations, including 2+ years owning a multi-platform SaaS environment end to end.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and supporting marketing automation or CRM platforms (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Proven integration skills: Zapier or Make, plus REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.
  • Comfortable writing light scripts (JavaScript or Python).
  • Experience with call tracking, telephony, or SMS platforms and their attribution data.
  • Track record of documenting systems and running vendor evaluations with clear recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of SaaS security: SSO, MFA, role-based access, offboarding, data retention.
  • Clear communicator who can explain trade-offs to non-technical leaders and train front-line staff.

Preferred

  • Experience in a law firm or another regulated, client-confidential service business.
  • FileMaker Pro development or administration experience.
  • Experience with Stripe, ACH, or bank verification providers.
  • Reporting and BI skills (SQL, Looker Studio, or similar) to build lead-to-revenue dashboards.
  • Has built or led a small team or managed outside contractors.

What success looks like

Targets are set with the COO in the first 90 days, once baselines exist.

Area

Measure

Reliability

Broken automations or integrations caught by monitoring before users report them

Support

Time to resolve system issues; repeat issues trending down

Documentation

Share of core systems with current configuration docs and a named owner (goal: 100%)

Growth

Speed-to-lead; share of signed clients with known marketing source

Payments

ACH return rate; time from payment to service start

Spend

Total license cost per employee; overlapping tools retired

Security

MFA and SSO coverage; offboarding completed same day

Adoption

Staff satisfaction with tools; training completed for core systems

Compensation and how to apply

  • Salary range: $3,000-$3,500 per month
  • To apply: send your resume and a short note describing one system you inherited, what was broken, and what you changed. Tell us what you measured before and after.
Salary: $3,000 – $3,500 / month

Security Engineer

Location: Remote (Must accommodate US East Coast working hours).

About Us

Partnerships are the future of go-to-market. They drive 30-50% of company revenue, yet most partner teams are stuck with spreadsheets, email chains, and outdated CRMs.

EULER is the AI-native PRM changing that, and we grew 600% last year doing it. We are not iterating on legacy PRM software. We are redefining what the category is.

Role Overview

As our Security Engineer, you will own the security of EULER's applications: making sure we follow sound security practices and that our platform keeps pace with current security standards.

You will review our platform end to end, from data access and backend services to APIs, integrations, and our AI layer. You will identify risks, explain them clearly, and recommend how to address them. Most fixes will be carried out by our engineering team with your guidance; some you will make yourself.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify risks. Run security reviews, code and configuration audits, and penetration tests across our applications, APIs, and integrations.
  • Secure our AI layer. Assess our AI agents and their integrations for prompt injection, excessive permissions, and unauthorized data access.
  • Recommend and prioritize fixes. Turn findings into clear recommendations for the engineering team, and implement fixes yourself where it makes sense.
  • Set and update the standard. Define secure development practices and keep them current as new threats and standards emerge.
  • Use AI-driven security tooling. Run open-source, agent-based security tools for continuous testing, and verify what they report.
  • Support customers. Join calls with customers' security teams and help answer technical security reviews.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in application security, product security, or security-focused software engineering.
  • Hands-on experience finding vulnerabilities in web applications and APIs (OWASP Top 10, access control, authentication, OAuth).
  • Solid knowledge of AI and LLM security, including prompt injection and agent permission design.
  • Experience using AI-agent-based security tools.
  • Ability to read code in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, and to write fixes when needed.
  • Strong written and spoken English, and comfort presenting on customer calls.

Nice to Have

raw.title: Associate Principal Electrical Engineer – BESS Design
raw.excerpt: Role Summary Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer for utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, including standalone storage and PV-plus-storage facilities.
raw.description:
Role Summary

Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer for utility-scale battery energy storage system (BESS) projects, including standalone storage and PV-plus-storage facilities. You will seal electrical design packages, own the technical direction of a program of BESS projects, and act as the PV/BESS group's main electrical point of contact for clients, EPC contractors, and authorities having jurisdiction. The storage projects you support will help turn renewable power generation into a source of dispatchable power, and your work will play a direct role in the energy transition. As an employee-owner, you will have a personal stake in the success of your projects and the organization as a whole.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

  • Serve as Engineer of Record for BESS and PV-plus-storage projects, sealing electrical drawings, calculations, and specifications in states where you hold licensure.
  • Direct BESS electrical design from conceptual layout through issued-for-construction, including DC block and PCS arrangements, MV collection, auxiliary power, grounding, and SCADA and communications interfaces.
  • Review and approve single-line and three-line diagrams, AC and DC cable sizing, grounding designs, and equipment specifications.
  • Establish design criteria for AC- and DC-coupled storage, augmentation strategies, and hybrid PV-plus-storage plants.
  • Evaluate battery enclosure, PCS, transformer, and switchgear submittals, resolving technical deviations with equipment manufacturers.
  • Coordinate BESS electrical studies, including short-circuit, arc flash, load flow, voltage drop, wire loss, auxiliary load, and ground grid analysis.
  • Integrate fire protection and hazard mitigation requirements, including NFPA 855 spacing and explosion control inputs, into the electrical design.
  • Resolve unusual technical conditions and design conflicts using expert judgment, seeking guidance only for program-level issues.

Project & Portfolio Execution

  • Oversee the technical and delivery performance of all BESS projects within an assigned program.
  • Approve scopes, budgets, and schedules for electrical design assignments, identifying risks or deviations early.
  • Prepare proposals and fee estimates for BESS electrical engineering services in collaboration with Business Development.
  • Lead and assign engineers and designers needed to complete deliverables across concurrent projects.
  • Lead and participate in BESS program reviews and client program meetings.
  • Mentor Engineer I–III and Senior Engineer staff in BESS design practice, code application, and Engineer of Record responsibilities.
  • Act as a supervisor of assigned staff, including performance feedback and development planning.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Review complete BESS design packages for conformity, constructability, and quality assurance before sealing.
  • Ensure designs comply with the NEC (including Articles 480, 690, 691, 705, and 706), NFPA 855 and 70E, UL 9540 and 9540A, IEEE 1547 and 2800, and applicable utility and AHJ requirements.
  • Set and maintain the group's BESS electrical design standards, templates, and calculation tools.
  • Resolve AHJ, utility, and third-party review comments and maintain records of sealed documents.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Act as one of the PV/BESS group's main electrical points of contact for clients, EPC contractors, and AHJs across a program of BESS projects.
  • Coordinate with civil, structural, High Voltage, and Power Systems Engineering teams on layouts, substation interfaces, and interconnection requirements.
  • Lead design reviews and technical meetings, presenting recommendations and trade-offs to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate technical scope and design changes with clients and contractors, documenting impacts on schedule and budget.

Program, Strategy & Innovation

  • Track BESS technology, code, and market developments, setting the group's design response to them.
  • Develop new techniques, tools, and improved processes for BESS electrical design and review.
  • Advise Revamp leadership as a technical specialist on energy storage design.
  • Represent Revamp in industry working groups and technical forums on energy storage.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties, including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Occasionally perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or similar applicable work experience.
  • 10+ years of electrical design experience on utility-scale power generation projects, with substantial experience specifically in solar PV or BESS design.
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in electrical engineering, with the ability to obtain licensure in additional states.
  • Experience serving as Engineer of Record or lead electrical engineer for utility-scale BESS projects.
  • In-depth knowledge of the NEC, NFPA 855, UL 9540 and 9540A, and IEEE standards that apply to energy storage and interconnection.
  • Experience designing MV collection systems, grounding systems, and BESS auxiliary power systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage scopes, budgets, and schedules across concurrent projects and to lead and mentor engineering teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting technical recommendations to clients and AHJs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering with a power systems focus.
  • PE licensure in multiple states or an active NCEES Record.
  • Proficiency with ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, CYMCAP, or comparable power analysis software, and with AutoCAD.
  • Experience with battery enclosure and PCS products from multiple manufacturers and with augmentation planning.
  • Experience with hybrid plant controls and SCADA integration for PV-plus-storage facilities.
  • Prior work in an engineering consulting, owner/developer, or EPC environment supporting utility-scale renewable projects.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

· Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program.

· Competitive compensation with bonus.

· Full benefits package offerings including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.

· Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.

· Monthly health and wellness stipend.

· Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.

· Paid parental leave.

· 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.

· Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the US since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp‑eng.com.

Disclaimers

Employment with Revamp Engineering Inc. may be subject to background checks that are permitted by applicable law and relevant to the position. Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

Automated Hiring Technology Notice. Revamp uses an automated application-review feature within BreezyHR, our applicant tracking system, to help our recruiting team organize and prioritize applications. It compares the information you submit (your resume or CV and your answers to application questions) against criteria our recruiting team sets for the role. The feature does not reject or advance candidates; all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team and hiring managers. A summary of BreezyHR’s most recent independent bias audit of this feature is available at Revamp retains application information indefinitely to consider candidates for future opportunities. For more information or to request a reasonable accommodation, contact the talent team. About Telos Media

Telos Media creates content that entertains, educates, and gets people thinking. From SolarBalls, where the planets have personalities and space science comes to life, to Run Monster Run, a 3D animated series following three young monsters in a suspiciously secret facility, and Mr. Spherical, we're building worlds, stories, and characters that entertain audiences around the globe.

We're a growing team of creators, builders, and big thinkers, and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of what we're building.

About the Role

We're looking for a Video Editor to help maintain and elevate the visual quality of SolarBalls across our 8 international channels.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Rebuilding and standardizing video compilations across all 8 channels.
  • Color-correcting main series episodes to improve their overall visual quality.
  • Adapting videos for different languages and handling text insertion on Shorts.
  • Keeping project files, assets, and exports organized.

The role starts with an intensive setup phase, followed by ongoing part-time support once the main workflows are established.

What You'll Be Obsessed About

Visual quality, consistency, and getting the details right.

You have a great eye for color and composition, notice when something looks off, and care about delivering polished content. You're also organized and enjoy keeping creative workflows running smoothly, even when dealing with multiple versions, languages, and assets.

What You'll Do

Rebuild and standardize compilations: Rebuild existing SolarBalls compilations from scratch in Premiere Pro, creating adapted versions for all 8 localized channels.

Elevate visual quality: Review and color-grade main series episodes before publishing, adjusting tones, contrast, and saturation to improve the overall look.

Support international channels: Work with different language versions, audio tracks, and text assets to make sure each version is properly adapted.

Handle text and graphic assets: Add provided titles and text to textless versions of Shorts, as well as manage titling, text animation, and other graphic elements when needed.

Keep projects organized: Maintain clean project files, folders, assets, audio tracks, and exports.

Collaborate on quality control: Work with the SolarBalls team and local channel directors to incorporate feedback and make sure deliverables are ready for publishing.

About You

  • You have a strong eye for visual quality and attention to detail. You can identify when colors, contrast, or saturation need adjustment.
  • You're confident working with Adobe Premiere Pro, including rebuilding videos, managing timelines, working with multiple audio tracks, and exporting.
  • You're comfortable with After Effects, including graphic assets, titles, text animation, and color correction.
  • You're organized and know how to manage project files, assets, and multiple versions without losing track of things.
  • You're reliable, efficient, and able to work independently once you understand the workflow.

Previous experience editing animated series, YouTube content, or multi-language video content is a plus.

This Probably Isn't for You If

  • You tend to overlook visual details or don't care much about consistency and polish.
  • You dislike repetitive tasks or organizing files and assets.
  • You need constant direction to manage your workload and deadlines.

What Success Looks Like

  • All existing SolarBalls compilations are rebuilt and standardized across the 8 channels.
  • Main series episodes consistently receive color correction before publishing.
  • Editing workflows are organized and easy to maintain.
  • The team can rely on you to handle recurring editing tasks independently.

Time Commitment & Availability

Month 1 – Setup & Implementation: Full-time (approximately 30–40 hours per week). The main focus will be rebuilding compilations, standardizing the process across all 8 channels, and establishing the initial color correction workflow.

Month 2 Onwards – Maintenance & Support: Part-time / on-demand (approximately 5–10 hours per week, depending on deliverable volume). The focus will shift to maintaining compilations, color-correcting new episodes, and handling recurring editing tasks around each release.

If you’re energized by sales, enjoy building guest relationships, and want a career with strong earning potential, this is an excellent opportunity. First‑year performers typically earn around $50K, with top performers reaching $80K. Experienced consultants earn $65K–$100K+.

You’ll work warm leads from a guaranteed database of interested guests and build long‑term relationships that fuel repeat and referral business.

Why You’ll Love This Job

  • Warm leads provided — you’ll connect with guests who have already expressed interest in cruising.
  • High earning potential — first‑year agents average ~$50K, top performers reach $80K, and experienced consultants earn $65K–$100K+.
  • Relationship‑driven work — help guests plan memorable vacations while building lasting connections.
  • Fully remote — enjoy a professional career from home with company‑provided equipment.
  • Real growth opportunities — structured training, support, and strong earning progression as your book of business expands.
  • Amazing travel perks — discounted cruises and benefits for you and your family.
  • Supportive, team‑oriented culture — be part of a respected brand that values service, teamwork, and doing the right thing.

What You’ll Do

  • Make 70+ outbound calls and 100+ emails per day
  • Engage warm leads and build long‑term relationships that drive repeat and referral business
  • Sell consultatively using strong listening and discovery skills
  • Manage your book of business and encourage repeat bookings
  • Meet or exceed daily and monthly sales metrics

What You Bring

  • Minimum 1 year of sales experience (3+ years outbound preferred)
  • Strong communication and relationship‑building skills
  • Ability to multitask in a fast‑paced sales environment
  • Comfortable with computer systems, phone software, and CRM tools
  • A driven, high‑energy mindset and desire to exceed goals

Schedule

  • Training starts Feb 2027
  • Training: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–4:30 PM PST (5 weeks)
  • Post‑training: 8‑hour shift between 7 AM–6 PM PST, Monday–Friday
  • Weekends as needed

Remote Work Requirements

  • High‑speed Cable or Fiber internet (no satellite or mobile)
  • Minimum speeds: 50 Mbps down / 12 Mbps up
  • Must use a hardwired Ethernet connection (Wi‑Fi not compatible)
  • Quiet working environment.

Not eligible for candidates residing in: AR, CA, CT, DE, HI, ME, MN, NH, NY, OK, OR, SD, VT, WA, WV, WY.

Benefits

  • Travel privileges for you and your family
  • Health benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Training, development, and tuition assistance

Ready to Start a High‑Earning Remote Sales Career?

Apply today and take the next step toward joining the Holland America Line team!
