raw.excerpt: Wholesale Sales & Account Manager Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.
raw.description:
Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.
  • Grow revenue across existing customer relationships.
  • Increase reorder frequency and average order size.
  • Reactivate inactive accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Build a strong network of retail partners.
  • Support the wholesale expansion of an emerging consumer brand.

Target Start Date: December 2026, with the goal of being fully prepared for the January wholesale market.

Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

raw.description:
CWI Works is recruiting for a Science Communications Specialist position through the Forest Service Experienced Services (FS-ACES) Program. This grant-administered program provides experienced professionals with an opportunity to support the mission and operations of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, U.S. Forest Service.

Role and Responsibilities

The Science Communications Specialist will work within the Adaptive Management sector of the Planning Service Organization, supporting nationwide planning efforts by analyzing and interpreting data and translating technical and scientific findings into clear, accessible information. The position will communicate data analysis results, resource assessments, and monitor outcomes through publicly available reports and other communication materials. These materials will help land managers and the public better understand a range of information, including spatial prioritization of active management activities and resource monitoring results.

Duties include:

  • Support mission-critical and priority land management plan revisions, amendments, and other planning efforts.
  • Serve as a senior planner or resource specialist, applying an understanding of U.S. Forest Service history, policies, and practices to advise on and support specific plan revisions, amendments, and other planning activities.
  • Provide implementation support and technical guidance to the Forest Service on planning communications, procedures, processes, and resource-specific topics.
  • Share expertise and provide knowledge transfer on effective approaches for communicating complex planning information, scientific findings, data analysis results, and resource assessments.
  • Advise and consult with staff involved in planning activities and develop, communicate, and share information on planning tools, resources, processes, and related authorities.
  • Review and analyze information to identify trends, patterns, and conditions, and translate findings into clear, accurate, and accessible language for public-facing materials and reports.
  • Develop and communicate technical and scientific information in formats that effectively convey complex findings to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must be 55 years of age or older and authorized to work in the United States; must have a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 20 years of relevant experience in a related field; have a thorough understanding of U.S. Forest Service history, policies, practices, and land management planning processes, demonstrated experience analyzing and interpreting scientific or resource-related data, identifying trends, and communicating technical findings; possess strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, understandable language for diverse audiences.

Hours & Compensation

Part-time position, up to 29 hours per week, at an hourly rate of $85.00.

raw.excerpt: The Role We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Creative Production Coordinator to own and coordinate our creative production workflows, initially focusing on User-Generated Content (UGC), with the opportunity to expand into other creative formats over time.
raw.description:
The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Creative Production Coordinator to own and coordinate our creative production workflows, initially focusing on User-Generated Content (UGC), with the opportunity to expand into other creative formats over time.

This is a project management and operations role. You won't be responsible for developing creative strategies or writing scripts. Instead, you'll ensure that every creative project moves smoothly from kickoff to delivery, that deadlines are consistently met, and that everyone involved knows exactly what needs to happen next.

Your mission is simple: keep creative production moving, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure projects are delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

1. UGC Creator Sourcing

  • Source UGC creators across different creator marketplaces.
  • Send them briefs, scripts, and production requirements provided by our Creative Strategists
  • Shortlist creators based on defined profiles, budgets, and project requirements.
  • Communicate with creators to coordinate production timelines and deliverables.

2. Creator & Production Management

  • Collect creator shipping information and coordinate product shipments with clients.
  • Track shipments and confirm creators have received their products.
  • Monitor production progress and ensure creators are filming according to agreed timelines.
  • Follow up with creators, identify delays, and resolve issues before they affect delivery dates.
  • Hold creators accountable for deadlines, deliverables, and production requirements.

3. Footage Quality Control

  • Review submitted UGC footage to ensure it meets production requirements.
  • Verify that all required script lines, product shots, and deliverables have been captured.
  • Check basic technical quality, including lighting, audio, framing, and footage usability.
  • Request reshoots or missing footage directly from creators when needed.
  • Download, organize, and upload approved raw footage to our Google Drive

4. Post-Production Coordination

  • Create and assign editing tasks in ClickUp with all necessary files, briefs, and instructions.
  • Coordinate handoffs between creators and video editors.
  • Track editing progress and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Follow up with editors when tasks are delayed or require attention.
  • Notify Creative Strategists when completed creatives are ready for internal review.
  • Coordinate additional editing rounds when revisions are requested.

5. Project Management & Reporting

  • Own and maintain accurate production dashboards showing the status of every creative project.
  • Track deadlines, deliverables, and project progress across multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Identify bottlenecks, anticipate delays, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide regular status updates to Creative Strategists and leadership.
  • Ensure that no project, task, or deliverable falls through the cracks.
  • Continuously improve production processes, documentation, workflows, and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Previous experience in project management, production coordination, creative operations, or a similar role.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proactive communication skills, including the confidence to follow up persistently and hold people accountable.
  • Ability to work independently, anticipate problems, and find solutions without constant supervision.
  • Experience using project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment with multiple stakeholders and tight deadlines.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience managing UGC creators or influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Experience with Influee or similar UGC platforms.
  • Familiarity with Meta advertising and eCommerce creative production.
  • Experience coordinating video editors or creative production teams.
  • Familiarity with Google Drive, Frame.io, and creative asset management workflows.
  • Experience using ClickUp & Slack
  • Previous experience working at a digital marketing or performance marketing agency.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when:

  • Creative projects are consistently delivered on or ahead of deadlines.
  • Creators and editors are proactively managed, with minimal delays or missed deliverables.
  • Every project has a clearly documented status, owner, and next step.
  • Potential problems are flagged and addressed before they become serious delays.
  • Creative Strategists spend significantly less time managing production logistics and more time focusing on strategy, creative direction, and client performance.
  • Stakeholders always have visibility into production progress without needing to chase updates.
  • Our creative production process becomes faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

Growth Opportunities

Initially, this role will focus primarily on UGC production. As your role evolves, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of additional production workflows, including video ads, static creatives, and other creative formats.

Over time, this position could evolve into a broader Creative Operations Manager role, overseeing the entire creative production pipeline across the agency.

We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills, and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

Role Summary

The Furniture Account Consultant plays a pivotal role in driving strategic growth within the Staples Service and Solutions Organization. Partnering with our KAE’s and Generalist Sellers, to develop furniture programs across all verticals and segments. The FAC serves as the furniture expert, alongside the KAEs, guiding the furniture solution for all sold furniture programs, which include customer standards programs, single project events, or other strategic holistic furniture programs created for each specific client. FACs will lead all facets of the sales process from developing the furniture programs, engaging our internal design support, and negotiating pricing and contracts. This role requires customer

outreach/engagement to drive transactional and programmatic furniture sales. The FAC must be well versed in Staples Furniture value proposition and strategic partner initiatives, and able to deliver solutions that meet customer requirements for budget, function, and timeline—ensuring a seamless and impactful customer experience.

  • Utilizes selling tools such as GPO’s, State and local contracts, and manufacturer-driven

purchasing agreements.

  • Effectively manage a sales funnel and pipeline to meet or exceed established KPIs

  • Partners with generalists to build and execute on transactional furniture strategy for targeted accounts.

  • Serve as furniture expert, presenting furniture insights/trends, best practices, solutions on generalist team calls and presentations to clients.

  • Responsible for executing sales campaigns and sales initiatives.

  • Develop solutions for customers, including product selection and specification by collaborating with our design team.

  • Pricing and product proposals to include identifying alternative products when applicable and necessary.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Collaborate with selling partners and work independently to market and generate sales through multiple approaches

  • Develops solutions for customers, including product selections

  • Research product solutions, delivery options, sourcing conditions

  • Pricing and product proposals to include identifying alternative products

  • Generates and revises quotes

Basic Qualifications

  • Preferred Bachelor’s Degree Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, or experience.

  • 4+ years Related work experience

  • Proven self-starter with energy and motivation to uncover, develop and close sales.

  • Ability to work independently with nominal supervision.

  • Ability to sell company values and services, in addition to program features and benefits via phone and internet, while some customer-facing presentations may surface on occasion.

  • Demonstrate strong time management skills with a high degree of understanding prioritization.

  • Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills while maintaining a professional appearance

  • Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills to be able to interact across the different departments within Staples Furniture as well as with clients, existing or prospect.

  • Context-switching expert: the ability to balance multiple concurrent responsibilities of varying priorities and to shift focus from one to another with minimal loss of productivity or work quality.

  • Problem Solving Skills with a Customer focused mentality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Furniture industry/product knowledge – ability to anticipate competitive positioning and respond; accordingly, knowledge of current industry trends in order to recommend relevant and leading edge solutions to customers, engaging manufacturing partners when necessary for competitive analysis.

  • Strong computer experience in MS Office Platforms, AS400 and furniture quoting software, Salesforce.com is a critical experience requirement.

raw.description:
About the Role

Run Monster Run is looking for creative editors who know how to turn animated chaos into scroll-stopping content!

We're talking funny moments, unexpected plot twists, iconic character moments, and clips that make people stop scrolling and send them straight to their friends. Your mission is to take our existing animation, particularly Episode 2, and turn it into short-form videos that people actually want to watch, share, and engage with.

We're not necessarily looking for professional video editors with years of experience. We're looking for people who genuinely enjoy making edits, understand internet culture, and have a good instinct for what makes content entertaining online. Think fan edits, creative cuts, memes, Reels, and the kind of videos that make a fandom come alive.

If you spend your free time editing videos for fun, experimenting with trends, or finding new ways to make existing content more entertaining, this could be right up your alley!

What You'll Do

  • Turn existing Run Monster Run animation into engaging, shareable short-form videos, particularly using footage from Episode 2.
  • Find the funniest, most surprising, dramatic, or memorable moments and turn them into clips that grab attention.
  • Experiment with different editing styles, pacing, hooks, captions, and formats to make each edit as engaging as possible.
  • Explore trends, memes, and fan-edit styles that could work well with Run Monster Run's characters and stories.
  • Create content that feels native to TikTok and Instagram Reels, with a strong understanding of how people consume and share videos on these platforms.
  • Bring your own creative ideas to the table and experiment with different ways to make our animation stand out online.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience creating short-form videos, fan edits, Reels, memes, or other social-media-first content.
  • A portfolio of edits that showcases your creativity, editing skills, and understanding of what makes content entertaining.
  • A strong instinct for identifying engaging moments and turning them into videos people want to watch and share.
  • A genuine interest in animation, internet culture, and online fandoms.
  • Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the trends and formats that work well on these platforms.
  • Creativity, initiative, and a willingness to experiment with different ideas and editing styles.

Overview

We are looking for a mid–senior Platform Engineer to support our IronGate application, an ETL platform running in AWS. You will be the primary owner of the cloud environment for this product, working closely with the application team to make our platform reliable, secure, and easy to operate.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building cloud infrastructure, setting up automation, and improving the way engineering teams deliver software.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment across development, staging, and production.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure, including S3, IAM, networking, and services that support secure file transfer and data movement.
  • Move the IronGate platform from manual setups to Infrastructure-as-Code, so environments are consistent and repeatable.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and secure configurations.
  • Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting so the team has clear visibility into system health and issues.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and other data storage solutions that support the IronGate data pipeline.
  • Collaborate closely with the IronGate product team (developers and product owners) to understand requirements and translate them into robust platform solutions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or similar role.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with AWS (e.g., S3, IAM, networking/VPC, security groups).
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, or similar.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK).
  • Experience applying security best practices in cloud environments.
  • Experience setting up monitoring and logging (e.g., CloudWatch or similar tools).
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL and familiarity with other data storage options.
  • Comfortable working as the primary platform owner for a product, while collaborating with other technical teams as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in regulated cloud environments, such as AWS GovCloud or environments governed by FedRAMP or DoD requirements.
  • Experience with AWS Transfer Family and AWS DataSync.
  • Experience with ETL or data pipeline workloads.
  • Experience supporting web application teams (e.g., React/Angular) from an infrastructure and deployment perspective.

What This Role Offers

  • A chance to be the primary platform engineer for a key application.
  • The opportunity to shape and standardize how we build and run cloud infrastructure.
  • Close collaboration with a product team delivering real value on top of modern AWS services.

raw.excerpt: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.
  • Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack
  • Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.
  • Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.
  • Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.


What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation
  • Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.
  • Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.
  • Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).
  • Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.
  • Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.


Nice to have

  • Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.
  • Reverse engineering and exploits development experience
  • Application security experience
  • Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.
  • Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.
  • Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).
  • Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.


Why this role at Nebius

  • Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the UK or EMEA region.

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Specialist works directly with hiring managers within an assigned business portfolio to effectively source, assess, and select talent that fit role, culture, and business requirements, and to provide coaching and guidance to hiring managers throughout the recruitment cycle. They will leverage data to contribute to strategic decisions about global hiring, including region, level, and offering, will contribute to and support the implementation of talent acquisition programs, guidelines, tools, and processes that ensure a world-class candidate experience and the selection of the very best talent.

What you will do

  • Partner with HR Business Partners, HR Advisors, and hiring managers to source, assess and select talent for requisitions in the organization, specializing in high-volume roles; in alignment with the company’s business needs and diversity practices
  • Be a trusted advisor to hiring managers, educating them on the recruitment process, interview techniques and selection criteria, and managing the flow and quality of candidates
  • Understand and proactively seek information about the business units within the portfolio, and Kinaxis in general; balance priorities of multiple hiring managers ensuring that a great candidate experience is the number one priority
  • The incumbent will understand that finding talent isn’t a “one size fits all” approach; develop sourcing strategies that meet the unique aspects of assigned roles.
  • Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals, to identify potential candidates; Actively search for passive candidates who may not be actively looking for new opportunities, and build and maintain a talent pipeline for future staffing needs.
  • Review resumes and applications to shortlist qualified candidates. Complete initial screening call with candidates, providing insight and assessment to hiring manager and recommending next steps
  • Be a Kinaxis brand advocate through the execution of end-to-end talent acquisition activities and processes to attract top talent within assigned portfolio area.
  • Promote the company’s recruitment brand through active participation in job fairs, conferences, and other networking and marketing events. Ensure timely communication with candidates, hiring managers, and vendors on the recruiting process and pending needs.
  • Assist in salary negotiations and facilitate the offer process, and ensure a smooth transition for candidates from accepting the offer to joining the organization.
  • Ensure that all talent acquisition activities and processes, including job postings and interviews, are executed in a way that fully support and enable the company’s diversity, equity, and inclusion strategies and goals; customize the approach as talent is engaged across multiple timezones and cultures
  • Network through industry contacts, memberships in professional associations and groups, and through employees
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition, and continuously evaluate and enhance recruitment processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree in Human Resources (or related field)
  • 4+ years of experience in progressively senior talent acquisition roles, in-house preferred
  • Experience working with a broad range of teams including Corporate Services teams (Finance, HR, Legal, IT, Marketing), Customer Support, Sales and Professional Services, in a high-tech, global environment
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high sense of urgency and an inventive approach to work through ambiguity and complex issues   
  • Highly adaptable and able to pivot based on prioritization and needs of the business 
  • Agile and resilient in managing multiple projects with multiple sources of information 
  • A clear, concise, and professional communicator with the ability to present information and demonstrate knowledge to stakeholders at varying levels within the business 
  • Strong work ethic, a high respect for confidentiality and sound professional judgment and initiative
  • Strong accountability and responsibility to meet aggressive deadlines

What we are looking for

  • Experience performing end-to-end recruitment cycle in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a passion for using data to drive decision making
  • Knowledge of recruiting database systems including applicant tracking systems
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Proven ability to balance a high number of open positions, managing roles globally across multiple teams and departments and locations.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to tie an organization’s business drivers to its hiring needs
  • Strong customer service orientation along with a high degree of attention to detail
  • Knowledge of employment and related legislation (Human Rights Code, and Employment Standards Act), contractual obligations, and sound human resource practices
  • Knowledge in immigration/work permit authorization
  • Strong sourcing capabilities to find top talent by leveraging social networks, research tools, as well as more creative techniques to identify potential talent
  • Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including behavioral interviewing techniques, and the ability to drive and manage the full recruitment cycle

#Term

Mid-Senior level - #Intermediate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P&G, Honda, and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs and training and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. raw.description:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

raw.description:
About Teikametrics

Teikametrics is transforming the future of eCommerce with our AI-powered Multi-Marketplace Optimization Platform, helping brands maximize sales across Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok. We are an AI-powered retail media company and an award-winning Walmart Connect partner, recognized for our work with Chinese brands. We already serve a strong base of China-based sellers, and we are investing more in China.

About the Role

Chinese brands are some of the fastest-growing sellers on Walmart and Amazon in the US. Many are still underserved: great products and capable in-house teams, but little expert help with upper-funnel advertising, AI-driven shopping and the shift to agentic commerce.

We are looking for one leader to own China growth: the strategy, the pipeline, the brand and the results. At the center is our agency service. Our experts run advertising and growth for leading brands, alongside their in-house teams, powered by our AI platform. You will take it to market and make it the standard for how Chinese brands grow on US marketplaces.

What You'll Own

China growth strategy and results. Set the growth plan for China and own the number. Work directly with the CEO and US leadership, and shape our offer, pricing and product with what you see in the market.

Agency service sales: Win China's leading marketplace brands as agency clients.

  • Lead with a growth audit that shows a brand where it is leaving money on the table, then turn it into an ROI case the owner signs.

  • Sell to founders and owners as well as e-commerce leads, including large sellers running separate Walmart, Amazon and TikTok Shop teams.

  • Position the service alongside the brand's in-house team. We take on what in-house teams struggle to do alone: upper-funnel advertising, AI-driven bidding, listings built for AI shopping assistants, and integration with the brand's own tools.

Growth of the base we already have: Expand current clients into agency service, and bring new brands onto our AI platform with a clear path to upgrade.

Marketing and brand in China: Make us the name Chinese brands think of for marketplace growth: WeChat and Channels content, webinars in Mandarin, invite-only roundtables, events, case studies and partner referrals.

Marketplace partnerships: Work hand in hand with Walmart and Amazon teams in China on referrals, co-hosted sessions and events.

The team: Hire and lead a sales and marketing team as the business scales, and partner with our service team to launch, keep and grow every brand you sign.

Who You Are

Agency experience is a must. You have sold and delivered managed advertising services to Chinese cross-border sellers, at a marketplace ads agency, an Amazon Ads or Walmart Connect partner, or a service provider. Software-only sales is not enough for this role.

  • Hands-on ads management depth: You have run, or led the people who ran, Sponsored Ads, DSP and upper-funnel campaigns on Walmart or Amazon, and you can talk ROAS, incrementality and measurement with a brand owner.

  • A track record of winning and keeping agency clients, including brands with their own in-house ads teams. You know how to make in-house staff see the service as support, not competition.

  • You have owned both sales and marketing, and built pipeline from WeChat, events, partners and marketplace teams, not only from inbound.

  • You have led a team of sellers, marketers or account managers.

  • Fluent Mandarin and professional English, based in or able to work from Shenzhen.

What Can Help You Stand Out

  • Relationships with Walmart or Amazon teams in China.

  • A network among China's leading consumer brands selling on US marketplaces.

  • Experience bringing AI or software to market alongside a service.

You will thrive here if you are a builder who wants to own a business, not just a quota. You are as comfortable with the founder of a fast-growing Shenzhen brand as with US leadership, and you move fast, test, learn and keep raising the bar.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days you know the market: the top Chinese sellers on US marketplaces, who serves them today, and where we win. You have run your first growth audits, signed your first agency clients, and tested the pitch with real brands.

In your first year agency service is a growing, repeatable business in China. China's leading brands see us as their growth partner, Walmart and Amazon see us as a go-to partner for Chinese sellers, and you have built a team around a playbook that works.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of China growth, with a direct line to the CEO and a real say in strategy, offer and product.

  • Competitive base salary plus meaningful upside tied to the growth you drive.

  • An AI platform and marketplace partnerships that give you an edge in every pitch.

  • A company investing in China, with room to build the team and the business your way.

  • Flexible working, with a Shenzhen base.

The job description is representative of typical duties and responsibilities for the position and is not all-inclusive. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with business needs. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. A background check will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment is extended.
The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to: skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes potential opportunities for bonus or commissions, and equity grants. Speak with your recruiter for more information.

WHY TEIKAMETRICS?

At Teikametrics, you’ll experience the excitement of a growth-stage company with the stability of an established market leader. You’ll also have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology that’s transforming the industry, while collaborating with top brands redefining the future of eCommerce. With a remote-first culture we value impact over location and you’ll have the flexibility to work when you’re most productive and effective. Join us on our mission to be the world’s leading Marketplace Optimization Platform, used by every seller and brand owner.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

Teikametrics will never ask you to communicate via WhatsApp, Telegram, or other messaging apps during our hiring process. We do not request payment, financial information, or purchases of equipment during recruitment. All legitimate job openings are posted on our official careers page at , and our recruiters will only contact you through LinkedIn or official company email addresses (@teikametrics.com).
If you're unsure about a communication you've received, please contact us directly at to verify.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

raw.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 7–11 Years
Openings: 1
Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Specialist – Data Engineering to design and establish scalable Data Lake/Lakehouse architectures for manufacturing and industrial data environments. The role involves building reliable data pipelines, implementing data governance and quality practices, enabling analytics and AI use cases, and assessing the security and compliance of ITAR-controlled data across the data landscape.

Job Description

The position focuses on defining and implementing data lake architecture to support manufacturing analytics, reporting, and applicable AI/ML use cases. The candidate will work with machine, equipment, MES, test, and probe data, ensuring accurate lot-, wafer-, and die-level traceability.

The role also involves evaluating existing data environments, strengthening data quality, lineage, governance, and access controls, and ensuring appropriate handling of ITAR-controlled information. The candidate will collaborate with technical teams and senior stakeholders to document findings, recommend improvements, and deliver scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable Data Lake/Lakehouse architectures across cloud or on-premises environments.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines for manufacturing, machine, equipment, MES, test, and probe data.
  • Establish data quality, governance, lineage, cataloguing, and traceability practices.
  • Develop data processing solutions using SQL, Python, Scala/Java, and Spark.
  • Implement data orchestration, streaming, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation.
  • Assess ITAR-controlled data classification, segregation, access, and security controls.
  • Enable analytics, reporting, and ML/AI use cases within manufacturing data environments.
  • Engage with stakeholders, document assessments, and communicate technical recommendations.

Required Skills

  • Data Engineering: Strong experience in enterprise data engineering, particularly in manufacturing, semiconductor, or industrial environments.
  • Data Lake/Lakehouse: Azure Data Lake, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Parquet-based storage, or equivalent architectures.
  • Programming: SQL and Python or Scala/Java.
  • Distributed Processing: Apache Spark.
  • Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP, or on-premises data platforms.
  • Orchestration & Streaming: Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Kafka, or Event Hubs.
  • DevOps: CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Data Governance: Data cataloguing, lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Analytics & BI: Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire.
  • AI/ML: Understanding of ML/AI data pipelines and manufacturing analytics use cases.
  • Security & Compliance: ITAR/EAR export controls, IAM, RBAC/ABAC, encryption, network segmentation, and audit logging.

Mandatory Skills

  • Azure Data Lake
  • Azure DevOps

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of data engineering experience, preferably in manufacturing, semiconductor, or industrial environments. They should possess strong hands-on expertise in data lake architecture, distributed data processing, and cloud data platforms, along with an understanding of manufacturing data traceability, governance, and security compliance. Strong stakeholder management, assessment, and documentation skills are essential.

Benefits Package

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients.

raw.description:
Do you want to help design and implement the next generation of cloud networking?

Do you want to dive deep into the inner workings of Virtual Private Clouds, dynamic tunneling and overlay routing?

Join our Routing Services team!

Akamai Cloud is the world's most distributed cloud platform. Our customers range from frontier AI companies to established market leaders. We own the host routing software stack, overlay network and the networking configurations that enable our customers to run massive computing workloads in our Cloud data centers.

Partner with the best

We are seeking an experienced data center network architect with a foundation in Linux systems and coding. You will serve as the crucial bridge between software engineering and network operations. You will balance the vast possibilities of software development with the strict demands of network reliability, maintainability, and operational realism.

As an Architect Senior, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring that software-driven network designs remain practical, highly reliable, and operationally sound in a massive-scale data center environment.
  • Defining the technical roadmap and architecture for large-scale data center overlay routing, tunneling, and multi-tenant VPC networking.
  • Architecting solutions for hitless control-plane restarts, sub-second failovers, graceful restart/BGP route-server topologies, and fault-isolation domains to ensure zero downtime during protocol state churn.
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Author high-impact Architecture and Design proposals; align with engineering SRE, Network Automation, and Product Management teams.
  • Working closely with peers, and coordinating with teams globally as part of designing new features, dealing with bugs or driving consensus on a technical solution.
  • Leading technical design reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers across software and network disciplines.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Bring experience architecting and operating commercial data center environments, (how network operators think and the realities of production networks).
  • Understand deeply the Linux kernel networking subsystem (Netlink sockets, network namespaces, FIB/routing tables, connection tracking, and packet flow lifecycles).
  • Excel in Modern DC Overlays and EVPN: Possess deep, practical knowledge of BGP EVPN and VXLAN.
  • Maintain sharp programming skills in systems languages (e.g., Go, C, or C++) for building proof-of-concepts, reviewing daemon source code, designing custom route-server or policy controllers,
  • Possess the ability to translate complex networking trade-offs into clear business and architectural decisions for executive leadership and product stakeholders.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Job Title: Account Director - Purplemoon

Job Location: Montclair, New Jersey, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Purplemoon, an IQVIA business, the Account Director is more than a project facilitator. As a senior day-to-day leader, they build trusted client relationships, lead integrated agency teams, and ensure work progresses strategically, efficiently, and with a high standard of quality. They develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses, anticipate needs and challenges, bring a clear point of view, and create the clarity, momentum, and confidence needed to keep clients and internal teams moving forward. Successful Account Directors are trusted advisors and leaders who stay closely connected to account activity without being involved in every detail, proactively bring solutions, know when to make decisions versus escalate, and ensure clients feel their business is understood and well managed while providing teams with the direction, context, and support needed to deliver exceptional work.

Responsibilities:

Client Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted day-to-day partner to clients, building strong relationships across brand and cross-functional teams
  • Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand strategy, competitive environment, customers, and business objectives
  • Lead client meetings and communications with confidence, ensuring conversations are focused, productive, and action-oriented
  • Anticipate client needs, identify potential issues early, and proactively recommend solutions
  • Provide thoughtful counsel and an agency point of view rather than simply executing client requests
  • Build relationships beyond immediate day-to-day contacts and help strengthen the overall agency-client partnership

Account & Strategic Leadership

  • Maintain a clear understanding of the strategic objectives behind agency assignments and ensure work remains connected to those objectives
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Creative, Medical, Project Management, Digital and other disciplines to develop integrated solutions
  • Translate client needs into clear, actionable direction for internal teams
  • Evaluate work before it reaches the client to ensure it addresses the brief, reflects client expectations, and meets Purplemoon standards
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the work, expand existing assignments, or bring forward new ideas that can help the client's business

Team Leadership

  • Provide clear direction and leadership to the account team while creating opportunities for more junior team members to grow
  • Establish clear roles, expectations, priorities, and next steps across assignments
  • Ensure internal teams have the context and information they need to do their best work
  • Create strong partnerships across disciplines and help resolve issues quickly when teams become misaligned
  • Coach and develop junior account team members, providing regular feedback and increasing their level of ownership over time
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, solutions-oriented team environment

Operational & Financial Management

  • Maintain command of account scope, budgets, timelines, staffing needs, and deliverables
  • Partner with Project Management to ensure work is appropriately planned, resourced, and delivered on time
  • Identify scope changes and financial risks early and address them proactively
  • Participate in the development of scopes of work, estimates, forecasts, and staffing plans
  • Understand account financials and help ensure work is delivered profitably and within agreed-upon scope
  • Maintain visibility across multiple concurrent workstreams and establish priorities when demands compete

Growth & Agency Contribution

  • Look beyond individual assignments to identify opportunities to deepen Purplemoon’s relationship with clients
  • Participate in annual planning, organic growth initiatives, new-business opportunities, and pitches as appropriate
  • Contribute ideas and perspectives that improve how Purplemoon works and serves its clients
  • Help build a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, and high standards

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of healthcare/pharmaceutical advertising or communications experience, with significant experience in account management
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical marketing and the healthcare communications environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex accounts, multiple workstreams, and cross-functional agency teams
  • Strong client relationship and presentation skills
  • Ability to think strategically while maintaining command of executional details
  • Experience managing scopes, budgets, timelines, and account financials
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving skills, and ability to operate independently
  • Experience coaching and developing junior team members
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial agency environment where individuals are expected to take ownership and help solve problems beyond the boundaries of their job description

Please Note: You must reside within the country where this role is posted to be eligible for this remote job opportunity.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. Ocean Associates, Inc. (OAI) is seeking a candidate to support to the NOAA’s National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS), Office of Protected Resources (OPR) in Silver Spring MD. The employee will provide OPR with inhouse capability for predictive sound source and expose modeling. This is a full-time position based on 40 hrs. /week with generous employee benefits. OAI is a Virginia corporation established in 2003 that provides consulting and technical services to the U.S. government, non-governmental organizations, international organizations, and the private sector. We specialize in scientific program and project management, strategic planning, professional and technical services, and stakeholder engagement, supporting government contracts.

NOTE: A cover letter that describes how your skills, experience and education meet the required qualifications of the position must be included with your resume when submitting the application and is mandatory.

Tasks

  • Support the development of NOAA ‘in-house’ capacity for predictive sound field and sound exposure modeling, including the assessment and procurement of existing software, as well as the design, development, and use of new software and tools to support the assessment of acoustic impacts on protected species and their habitat, as well as NOAA’s broader Ocean Noise Strategy goals.
  • Assist by coordinating with the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), as necessary to maximize synergy with their similar in-house model development and work closely with OPR managers and others, as assigned, to ensure the resulting product supports NMFS’ management needs.

Start Date:Immediate after completing security background check

Location:Work may be performed offsite

Salary and Benefits: This is a full-time position with benefits. Salary: $37.00 to $40.00 per hour.

Requirements

Applicants must have the following minimum requirements:

  • Master’s Degree or higher in a physical science (e.g. acoustics, physics, engineering, oceanography and three years of relevant experience or PHD and one year of relevant experience
  • Significant experience with scientific computing
  • Use of numerical propagation models (e.g. PE, ray tracing, normal modes), analysis and processing of underwater acoustic data (e.g. signal processing, detectors, filters), oceanographic data (e.g. bathymetry, sound speed profiles), scientific software development with python, version control systems (e.g. Git),
  • Familiarity with common anthropogenic sound sources (e.g. airguns, explosives, pile driving),
  • Familiarity with marine bioacoustics and the NMFS acoustic technical guidance, and general expertise in underwater acoustics including knowledge of source and propagation models

  • Experience developing detailed project plans, timelines, resource allocations, and budgets, including estimation for data and analytics workstreams

  • 4+ years of client account management experience
  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed

The Senior HRIS Analyst is responsible for the development, implementation, and ongoing optimization of HRIS solutions, with a primary focus on enabling scalable, compliant, and efficient HR operations. This role operates with advanced expertise to design, configure, and support system capabilities (including Workday), while influencing processes, standards, and cross-functional integration across the HR ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

HRIS Solution Design & Delivery

  • Translate business requirements into system solutions, workflows, and reporting models

Workday (or HRIS) Expertise & Capability Building

  • Serve as a subject matter resource in HRIS platforms, building depth in Workday functionality and best practices
  • Apply advanced knowledge to optimize system usage, improve user experience, and drive adoption
  • Identify and implement process and system improvements based on data, trends, and business needs
  • Support testing, releases, and continuous improvement cycles

Data, Reporting & Insights

  • Design and deliver advanced reporting capabilities across HR systems to support HR and business decision-making
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and integrity across HR systems
  • Develop complex reporting solutions and automation to improve efficiency and insight generation

Problem Solving & Innovation

  • Analyze complex issues involving multiple variables and systems; develop creative and effective solutions
  • Establish new approaches, frameworks, or processes where existing ones do not fully meet needs
  • Exercise judgment in adapting system configurations, business processes, or reporting methodologies

Collaboration & Influence

  • Partner across HR COEs and business stakeholders to align system capabilities with business priorities
  • Communicate complex system concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Influence decisions through data, expertise, and practical recommendations
  • Provide guidance and informal leadership to team members on HRIS practices and standards

Transformation & Change Enablement

  • Support organizational transformation through adoption of new systems, processes, and ways of working
  • Contribute to establishing new standards for HRIS delivery, service models, and operating practices
  • Demonstrate adaptability in evolving environments with shifting priorities and expectations

Knowledge & Application

  • Applies deep HRIS expertise and business acumen to design and deliver complex solutions
  • Understands interdependencies across HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT systems
  • Contributes to development of new processes, standards, and system capabilities

Complexity & Problem Solving

  • Handles complex assignments requiring evaluation of multiple data sources, systems, and business factors
  • Determines appropriate methods and approaches for new or ambiguous challenges
  • Exercises strong judgment in decision-making and solution design

Collaboration & Influence

  • Builds strong partnerships across teams and functions
  • Advises stakeholders on complex system and process decisions
  • Adapts communication style to influence and align across audiences

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of HRIS experience, including Workday administration, configuration, and support.
  • Strong knowledge of HR processes and systems, including HR, Payroll, and Finance integrations.
  • Experience translating business requirements into scalable system solutions and process improvements.
  • Advanced reporting and data analysis skills with a focus on data integrity and governance.
  • Experience supporting system testing, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting HR technology, transformation, and change management initiatives.
  • Workday certification(s) preferred.

About AiDASH

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

The Role

AiDASH is helping electric utilities and infrastructure providers improve reliability, reduce risk, and make smarter decisions for their operations. Our SaaS platform combines satellite data, analytics, and practical insights to support critical day-to-day work like vegetation management and storm preparedness.

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) to drive long-term success for our strategic North American customers. As the primary point of contact for a portfolio of active SaaS accounts, you'll own customer satisfaction, engagement, and retention - ensuring our customers consistently realize value from our platform. You’ll build trusted relationships across all levels, from field managers to executive stakeholders, becoming a go-to partner in their day-to-day operations and long-term planning. You’ll join a high-impact Customer Success team made up of CSMs, Product Consultants, and Project Managers - all committed to delivering measurable outcomes together.

You’ll be joining a high-performing Customer Success team that includes CSMs, Product Consultants, and PMs who work closely together to deliver outcomes. This is a relationship-driven role suited for someone who thrives in high-ownership environments, enjoys supporting real-world operations, and brings strong follow-through to everything they do.

Why AiDASH?

Our customers are on the front lines of the energy transition, climate adaptation, and infrastructure modernization. This role gives you a seat at the table with decision-makers who are responsible for keeping the lights on, managing vegetation risk, and meeting regulatory standards. You’ll join a team that’s collaborative, mission-focused, and committed to delivering outcomes that matter.
We’re also growing fast. This role offers a path to expand your impact - whether deepening relationships in strategic accounts, mentoring others, or helping shape the future of customer experience at AiDASH.
If you care about helping customers succeed and want to work on meaningful infrastructure challenges, we’d love to hear from you!

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own a portfolio of multi-year AiDASH customers, driving deep engagement, strong adoption, and long-term retention
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across field teams, operations, and leadership
  • Lead regular check-ins, training sessions, and strategic planning meetings to keep customers informed, aligned, and empowered
  • Monitor product usage, customer health, and feedback to proactively surface risks and uncover new opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with Product Consultants, Project Managers, Support, and Sales to solve challenges and improve customer outcomes
  • Play a key role in renewals and expansion efforts, working hand-in-hand with Sales to grow customer value and impact

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or related post-sales roles within B2B SaaS or infrastructure sectors
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across all levels of the customer organization - from field managers to senior executives
  • Highly organized and dependable, with a proven ability to manage multiple accounts and competing priorities effectively
  • Quick learner and confident in explaining software platforms and data dashboards to diverse audiences
  • Experience working with utilities, infrastructure operators, or field-heavy industries is a strong plus

What you'll love:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA): 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
  • 401(k) Plan: Begin contributing after three months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered

  • Generous Vacation Policy: Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.
