About the Role:   

The Sr. Project Engineer manages the engineering strategy, design, and standards for a customer (or program), and is viewed as the engineering expert for that program. The Program Engineer’s sphere of influence starts with an RFP or concept and extends through as-built submission to ensure consistency of design and messaging to customers, the internal team, and vendors/subcontractors.

As a Program Engineer, you’ll work closely with Program and Account Managers to understand anticipated work in your program. You’llalso work with each engineering discipline through the different stages of a projectto ensure that strategy, engineering standards, and an excellent customer relationshipismaintained.We’ll appreciate your insightful leadership, communication skills, and thorough knowledge of your customer as you guide engineerswithin your program. 

In this role, you will…

  • Provide input to engineering teams throughout the full lifecycle of a project to ensure correct equipment & spec is incorporated into designs, promote value engineering, and ensure standardization
  • Estimate the engineering effort for bid purposes and contribute to precontract project planning
  • Work with Engineering Leadership to plan the “Program Team” – how many resources, what skills are needed, etc, for future projects
  • Aid in the transition of projects from Pre-contract to Post-contract
  • Attend meetings relevant to the program (internal and external, project and non-project) as required
  • Manage and be knowledgeable in all aspects of the customer spec (conveyor, structural, safety, etc…)
  • Train engineers and other team members on customer requirements, standards, and specifications
  • Travel to job sites and customer offices as needed; travel estimated at 10-15%
  • Act as liaison between DCS and the customer on spec questions and as the escalation point for internal project teams when spec disputes arise
  • Provide input to management in customer strategy discussions
  • Work with customer’s engineering team to understand, improve and implement new designs

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have BS in a technical discipline (ME, EE, other engineering, or equivalent experience)
  • You have 5+ years of experience integrating material handling system solutions and have a thorough knowledge of your customer’s conveyance systems and engineering requirements
  • You’re familiar with the full lifecycle of the design process and the installation/integration process
  • You’re proficient in AutoCAD & and have working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
  • You possess excellent communication skills, both written and spoken, and adapt effectively to various audiences, including internal teams, clients, and management
  • You are assertive and comfortable driving initiatives independently
  • You’re a self-motivated performer who can work with minimal supervision and high-level project guidance

About Us:

Conveyor may be in our name, but it’s only part of what we do. DCS was founded in 1982, and has grown to serve major clients in multiple industries by providing material handling, full-scale warehouse operations and conveyor design solutions that are custom crafted for their need. We don’t sell ready-made systems - we build relationships that empower us to craft custom solutions together. It’s the teamwork approach, sharing ideas and building upon them, that produces the best results.

And DCS is committed to creating an extraordinary employment experience for our team. We work like crazy to hire and develop great people, build relationships, and ensure that the programs and services we offer our team are among the best in the business- from a killer snack wall and casual work environment to flexible PTO and opportunities to give back within the community.

More Reasons to Join Our Team:

  • We pride ourselves in our family-like culture and casual, but focused, work environment
  • We offer competitive salaries and health benefits
  • Our 401K program includes a 100% match up to 5%
  • Participation in our Discretionary Profit-Sharing Program
  • We offer our employees flexibility and autonomy
  • We do community outreach projects throughout the year
  • We know how to throw company events
  • We work hard, but we also know how to have fun - darts, anyone?

Individuals seeking employment at Designed Conveyor Systems are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Accommodation is available to applicants with a disability condition, when applying, testing, or interviewing for a position. Please let us know if you need accommodation.

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a Manager, Public Affairs Communications to help advance the company's public affairs priorities through strategic communications, thought leadership, stakeholder engagement, and policy-focused storytelling.

Reporting to the Director of Public Affairs Communications, this role will serve as a key communications partner to the Public Policy & Government Affairs, Legal, and Corporate Communications teams. The position will help elevate Lumen's voice on issues that impact the company's business, customers, communities, and the broader digital economy.

This role is ideal for a communications professional who have experience working with the legislative or executive branches of government and translating complex policy topics into compelling, understandable content for external audiences.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute communications strategies that support Lumen's public policy, government affairs, and corporate reputation priorities.
  • Translate complex policy and regulatory issues into clear, compelling communications for policymakers, stakeholders, media, and external audiences.
  • Support integrated communications campaigns around key corporate initiatives, including digital infrastructure, AI, cybersecurity, economic development, and permitting reform.
  • Partner closely with Government Affairs, Legal, and business teams to ensure communications align with company priorities.
  • Identify and develop opportunities to elevate Lumen leaders through speaking engagements, panel discussions, industry events, opinion content, and external thought leadership platforms.
  • Draft talking points, briefing materials, Q&As, presentations, and background documents for executive appearances.
  • Develop executive content strategies that grow visibility among policymakers, industry influencers, third-party organizations, and key stakeholder groups.
  • Develop content that demonstrates Lumen's role in powering the digital economy and enabling economic growth, innovation, security, and connectivity.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify customer stories, case studies, videos, reports, and other assets that reinforce policy objectives.
  • Support public affairs campaigns through articles, blog posts, newsletters, web content, social content, and executive communications.
  • Support relationships with think tanks, trade associations, policy organizations, industry coalitions, and other external stakeholders.
  • Track speaking opportunities, awards programs, partnerships, and sponsorships that support public affairs objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Lumen's visibility and credibility among policy audiences and industry influencers.
  • Work closely with the external communications, social media, creative, and marketing teams to maximize the impact of public affairs initiatives.
  • Ensure public affairs messages are integrated into broader corporate communications campaigns.
  • Track program performance and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, political science or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in public affairs, public policy communications, corporate communications, government relations communications, or related fields, ideally within the telecommunications, technology, cybersecurity, energy, or related industries.
  • Experience engaging with policymakers, trade associations, think tanks, industry coalitions, or other organizations.
  • Familiarity with communications strategies that support advocacy, reputation management, stakeholder engagement, and executive thought leadership.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex policy, regulatory, and technical topics for diverse audiences.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously, navigate ambiguity, and deliver results across competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and take ownership of complex public affairs initiatives, building trusted relationships across stakeholders and advancing workstreams with minimal oversight.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

$105,786 - $141,047 in these states: AL AR AZ FL GA IA ID IN KS KY LA ME MO MS MT ND NE NM OH OK PA SC SD TN UT VT WI WV WY

We're able to answer any additional questions you may have about our bonus structure (short-term incentives, long-term incentives and/or sales compensation) as you move through the selection process.

Life at Lumen

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:

Background Screening

If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page. Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Overview

At ALTOUR, we believe people are the driving force behind every meaningful connection - our clients’ and our own. With more than 1,000 team members and a presence in over 80 countries, we are a globally recognized leader in corporate travel management and a proud division of Internova Travel Group, the highest-ranking American corporate travel management company (Business Travel News).

Our mission is to manage the complexities of connecting people so they can represent their brands in the most impactful way possible. That same philosophy shapes our workplace culture, one that evolves, improves, and empowers our people to grow and thrive.

We embrace innovation and leading-edge technology to create smarter, faster, and more tailored solutions - not just for our clients, but for each other. At ALTOUR, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your voice matters and your success is a shared journey. Click here for more information about Altour.

JOB OVERVIEW

This is an exciting opportunity for the successful candidate to achieve a fully funded BSc in Business-to-Business Sales Level 6 Apprenticeship qualification through Middlesex University, alongside gaining practical commercial experience.

The Inside Sales Executive is responsible for converting marketing-generated leads, self-generated prospects and inbound enquiries into qualified sales opportunities for both our corporate and meeting & events business units. The role acts as the bridge between marketing activity and revenue generation, building pipeline, qualifying prospects and creating sales opportunities for the wider sales team.

This position is ideally suited to candidates wishing to embark upon a career in Business-to-Business Sales and provides a development pathway into a field sales or business development role.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development

  • Develop and maintain target account lists aligned to business growth objectives.
  • Re-engage dormant CRM opportunities and identify new prospective clients.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through telephone, email, LinkedIn and other channels.
  • Execute structured outreach campaigns to generate qualified meetings and opportunities.

Sales Qualification & Opportunity Management

  • Qualify inbound enquiries and outbound prospects against agreed criteria.
  • Understand client travel programmes, requirements and business challenges.
  • Identify contract renewal dates, buying cycles and decision-making processes.
  • Progress qualified prospects into active sales opportunities and handover to the Director of Sales/MICE Business Development Manager.

CRM, Reporting & Forecasting

  • Maintain CRM accuracy and data integrity.
  • Track prospect engagement and campaign effectiveness.
  • Provide pipeline forecasts and client review planning information.
  • Prioritise opportunities based on likelihood of conversion and commercial value.

Stakeholder Engagement & Professional Development

  • Build relationships with key decision makers and influencers.
  • Work closely with marketing to maximise lead conversion.
  • Represent the business professionally across all customer interactions.
  • Actively participate in apprenticeship learning, projects and professional development activities.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications

  • GCSE English and Mathematics (or equivalent) at Grade 4/C or above.
  • Two A-levels at grade D or above, or equivalent qualifications
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to engage business stakeholders
  • Ability to organise workload, manage multiple priorities and work towards performance targets
  • Demonstrable interest in sales, business development, account management or customer relationship management
  • Good digital literacy, including Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Excellent communication, questioning and active listening skills.
  • Confidence conducting telephone, email and social selling activities.
  • Strong research, account planning and prospecting capability.
  • Ability to build professional relationships with business customers.
  • Analytical approach to interpreting customer information and sales data.
  • High level of motivation, resilience and willingness to learn.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office and digital collaboration tools.
  • Understanding of professional conduct and customer service standards.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • 0 – 2 years’ experience in sales, lead generation, customer service or business development roles.
  • Knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Salesforce, ZoomInfo or similar platforms.
  • Awareness of B2B sales methodologies, pipeline management and forecasting principles.
  • Corporate travel, business services or professional services industry knowledge.
  • Experience working to KPIs, targets or performance metrics.
  • Understanding of consultative selling and account management practices.

PAY AND BENEFITS

Our benefit offerings include;

  • A discretionary incentive plan based on individual performance.
  • Statutory Pension Scheme (auto enrolment after 3 months service)
  • 25 days annual leave entitlement per calendar year plus public holidays. This entitlement increases with length of service after 5 years with the company
  • AVIVA Life Insurance inclusive of counselling and Employee Assistance Programme
  • Medicash Private Medical Insurance
  • BUPA Dental care
  • Group Income Protection cover with MetLife

Internova Travel Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, gender, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation and gender identity or any other protected class.

raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the UK or EMEA region.

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Specialist works directly with hiring managers within an assigned business portfolio to effectively source, assess, and select talent that fit role, culture, and business requirements, and to provide coaching and guidance to hiring managers throughout the recruitment cycle. They will leverage data to contribute to strategic decisions about global hiring, including region, level, and offering, will contribute to and support the implementation of talent acquisition programs, guidelines, tools, and processes that ensure a world-class candidate experience and the selection of the very best talent.

What you will do

  • Partner with HR Business Partners, HR Advisors, and hiring managers to source, assess and select talent for requisitions in the organization, specializing in high-volume roles; in alignment with the company’s business needs and diversity practices
  • Be a trusted advisor to hiring managers, educating them on the recruitment process, interview techniques and selection criteria, and managing the flow and quality of candidates
  • Understand and proactively seek information about the business units within the portfolio, and Kinaxis in general; balance priorities of multiple hiring managers ensuring that a great candidate experience is the number one priority
  • The incumbent will understand that finding talent isn’t a “one size fits all” approach; develop sourcing strategies that meet the unique aspects of assigned roles.
  • Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals, to identify potential candidates; Actively search for passive candidates who may not be actively looking for new opportunities, and build and maintain a talent pipeline for future staffing needs.
  • Review resumes and applications to shortlist qualified candidates. Complete initial screening call with candidates, providing insight and assessment to hiring manager and recommending next steps
  • Be a Kinaxis brand advocate through the execution of end-to-end talent acquisition activities and processes to attract top talent within assigned portfolio area.
  • Promote the company’s recruitment brand through active participation in job fairs, conferences, and other networking and marketing events. Ensure timely communication with candidates, hiring managers, and vendors on the recruiting process and pending needs.
  • Assist in salary negotiations and facilitate the offer process, and ensure a smooth transition for candidates from accepting the offer to joining the organization.
  • Ensure that all talent acquisition activities and processes, including job postings and interviews, are executed in a way that fully support and enable the company’s diversity, equity, and inclusion strategies and goals; customize the approach as talent is engaged across multiple timezones and cultures
  • Network through industry contacts, memberships in professional associations and groups, and through employees
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition, and continuously evaluate and enhance recruitment processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree in Human Resources (or related field)
  • 4+ years of experience in progressively senior talent acquisition roles, in-house preferred
  • Experience working with a broad range of teams including Corporate Services teams (Finance, HR, Legal, IT, Marketing), Customer Support, Sales and Professional Services, in a high-tech, global environment
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high sense of urgency and an inventive approach to work through ambiguity and complex issues   
  • Highly adaptable and able to pivot based on prioritization and needs of the business 
  • Agile and resilient in managing multiple projects with multiple sources of information 
  • A clear, concise, and professional communicator with the ability to present information and demonstrate knowledge to stakeholders at varying levels within the business 
  • Strong work ethic, a high respect for confidentiality and sound professional judgment and initiative
  • Strong accountability and responsibility to meet aggressive deadlines

What we are looking for

  • Experience performing end-to-end recruitment cycle in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a passion for using data to drive decision making
  • Knowledge of recruiting database systems including applicant tracking systems
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Proven ability to balance a high number of open positions, managing roles globally across multiple teams and departments and locations.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to tie an organization’s business drivers to its hiring needs
  • Strong customer service orientation along with a high degree of attention to detail
  • Knowledge of employment and related legislation (Human Rights Code, and Employment Standards Act), contractual obligations, and sound human resource practices
  • Knowledge in immigration/work permit authorization
  • Strong sourcing capabilities to find top talent by leveraging social networks, research tools, as well as more creative techniques to identify potential talent
  • Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including behavioral interviewing techniques, and the ability to drive and manage the full recruitment cycle

#Term

Mid-Senior level - #Intermediate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P&G, Honda, and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs and training and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. We strive to make our website and application process accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at . Position Summary

Amerit Fleet Solutions, one of the leading fleet maintenance companies in the U.S., is seeking an experienced, inspired and mission-driven Director of Employee Relations to join our growing team! 

The Employee Relations (ER) team supports the organization by addressing workplace concerns fairly, consistently, and respectfully through strong intake, effective case resolution, and sound employment practices.

The Director, Employee Relations leads Amerit's Employee Relations function, setting the strategy, standards, and operating discipline for how the organization identifies, investigates, and resolves employee relations matters across a multi-site, field-based workforce. This role owns the ER team's highest-risk work, including EEOC and other agency charge response, and oversight of complex and sensitive workplace investigations. The Director serves as the primary connection point to Legal on employee relations matters and partners closely with the Director, People Business Partners and People Business Partners (PBPs) to ensure ER and PBP work in close alignment, with clear escalation discipline, on employee matters across the business.

The ideal candidate combines deep employee relations and labor relations expertise with strong people leadership skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to build scalable, defensible ER practices in a fast-paced, multi-site operational environment.

Compensation: Competitive Pay - Paid weekly, every Friday! Salary Range: $155,000 - $175,000 base depending on experience with bonus potential.

The benefits of belonging – what’s in it for you?

  • Full benefits within 30 days
  • Medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, life insurance, disability insurance
  • 401(k) match program
  • Unlimited vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Commitment to your safety through boot and prescription safety glasses reimbursement
  • Career and learning development with an extensive training program through our Amerit University
  • Employee referral program, up to $500 bonus
  • ASE certification program with fee reimbursement and bonus
  • Employee recognition platform that includes opportunities to redeem points for merchandise
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 24/7 nurse triage line
  • Employee discounts on cell phone service and entertainment tickets
  • Employee resource groups (ERGs) that foster inclusion

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & ER Function Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5, including a Senior Employee Relations Case Manager, Employee Relations Case Managers, and an ER Intake Coordinator.
  • Set caseload standards, quality expectations, and escalation criteria across the ER team; ensure consistent, timely, and well-documented case resolution.
  • Own ER tools, templates, playbooks, and case management systems; drive continuous improvement in intake, investigation, and documentation practices.
  • Build team capability and bench strength through coaching, calibration, and knowledge-sharing across case managers.

Investigation Oversight & Case Management

  • Provide oversight and quality assurance on complex, high-risk, and precedent-setting investigations led by the Senior Case Manager and Case Managers.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for the ER team on the most sensitive matters, including those involving senior leaders, significant legal exposure, or reputational risk.
  • Review and approve findings, recommendations, and documentation on the highest-risk matters to ensure consistency, sound judgment, and defensible outcomes.
  • Partner with the Senior Employee Relations Case Manager to maintain investigation standards, case strategy, and coaching for the broader case manager team.

Legal & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Employee Relations connection to Legal, routing matters appropriately and ensuring timely, well-prepared handoffs on litigation holds, subpoenas, and legal inquiries.
  • Partner with Legal and outside counsel on separations, settlements, and other high-risk employment actions.
  • Partner with Safety, Compliance, and business leaders on matters requiring coordinated response.

Partnership with People Business Partners

  • Partner closely with the Director, People Business Partners to reinforce role clarity and escalation discipline between the PBP and ER functions.
  • Ensure PBPs are equipped to identify, escalate, and partner on ER issues in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Support leadership coaching on employee issues in alignment with ER guidance, balancing employee experience with risk mitigation and compliance.

Data, Reporting & Risk Management

  • Track and report on ER case volume, trends, cycle time, and outcomes to the AVP, Employee Experience and other senior leaders.
  • Identify systemic themes and risks across cases and recommend policy, training, or process improvements.
  • Own Employee Relations policy content and ensure policies remain current, consistent, and legally compliant across jurisdictions.

Charge Response & Regulatory Matters

  • Own the organization's response to EEOC charges and other administrative agency complaints (e.g., state fair employment agencies, DOL), partnering with Legal and outside counsel as needed.
  • Ensure timely, well-documented, and legally sound positions statements and supporting documentation for all charges and claims.
  • Track charge and claim trends; identify systemic risks and recommend policy, training, or process changes to reduce exposure.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required; advanced degree or JD a plus.
  • 10+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with significant depth in employee relations, workplace investigations, and labor relations.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing case managers or similar HR professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading union avoidance strategy and responding to union organizing activity.
  • Experience managing EEOC charges and other agency complaints, including direct partnership with Legal and outside counsel.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local labor and employment law across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience in multi-site, field-based, or operational workforce environments strongly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional judgment in high-risk, ambiguous, and sensitive situations.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop a team of case managers, with strong coaching and calibration skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and advise senior leaders and Legal.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends and translate case data into risk insights and process improvements.
  • Ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site operational environment.

Preferred

  • HR certification (SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or equivalent).
  • Experience with HR case management platforms (e.g., AllVoices, EthicsPoint, Navex).
  • Prior experience partnering directly with in-house or outside labor and employment counsel.

Company Name

ARS-Rescue Rooter

Overview

The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution.

The role is DevOps-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure-as-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards.

The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Azure Infrastructure Engineering & Operations

  • Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on-call.

Hybrid Networking, DNS & Application Delivery

  • Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior.
  • Design name resolution across Azure and on-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding).
  • Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints.
  • Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure-mode design when an edge service or policy fails.
  • Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third-party connectivity.

Migration Execution

  • Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift-and-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post-migration support.
  • Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off-hours production cutovers.
  • Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs).
  • Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads.

Resiliency, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo-redundant storage, and region/availability-zone design against RTO and RPO targets.
  • Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results.

Platform Services Infrastructure

  • Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring.
  • Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift.
  • Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self-hosted agents reaching private endpoints.
  • Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI.

Identity, Security & Governance

  • Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties.
  • Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence.

Observability & Cost Management

  • Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing.
  • Right-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines.

Collaboration & Cross-Training

  • Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Note: Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • 5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on production Azure.
  • Hybrid networking: hands-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior.
  • On-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration support.
  • Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets.
  • Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines.
  • Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy.
  • Independent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Azure issues.
  • Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge

  • Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel.
  • AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-500, AZ-400) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current.
  • AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations.
  • PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi-site hybrid environments.
  • Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting.

Work Details

  • Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone.
  • Regular business hours with scheduled after-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on-call as required; participation in change management (CAB).
  • Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Recognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities.

Job Summary

Take ownership of complex workers comp claims from initial investigation through resolution, using your experience and judgment to make sound coverage, liability, and settlement decisions. This is an active claims desk, strong organization, time management, and the ability to effectively prioritize a busy workload are important to success.

Work Location

This position offers both remote and hybrid work locations.  Candidates who reside within 50 miles of an office location (West Bend, Madison, Appleton) will be offered a hybrid work schedule.  Candidates who are fully remote (beyond 50 miles) may occasionally be asked to travel to an office location for in-person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and corporate events. 

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Summary of Responsibilities

Take ownership of complex workers comp claims from initial investigation through resolution, using your experience and judgment to make sound coverage, liability, and settlement decisions. This is an active claims desk, strong organization, time management, and the ability to effectively prioritize a busy workload are important to success.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage complex and higher-exposure workers comp claims with minimal supervision.
  • Research policy language and develop well-supported coverage decisions.
  • Conduct thorough investigations and evaluate liability, damages, reserves, and settlement strategy.
  • Negotiate effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, and other involved parties.
  • Oversee litigated files and partner with counsel to develop appropriate resolution strategies.
  • Proactively manage a busy caseload while maintaining accurate reserves, timely follow-up, and strong file documentation.
  • Present complex claims to Committee and clearly communicate recommendations.
  • Collaborate with teammates and internal partners to resolve claims effectively.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor to others on the Claims team.
  • Deliver a high level of customer service while meeting department quality and audit standards.

Preferred Experience and Skills

We’re looking for an experienced claims professional who is comfortable managing a fast-moving, active desk and brings strong judgment, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Prior experience handling large, complex, or higher-exposure claims.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong investigation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong time management, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • A team-oriented approach and willingness to collaborate and support others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, and internal partners.
  • Comfort working independently and making decisions while knowing when to collaborate or escalate.
  • Proficiency with claims technology and other computer-based tools.
  • Experience handling claims in Nebraska, Kansas, and/or Missouri is preferred. Experience in Kansas and Missouri is especially valuable as we continue to grow in these markets.

Preferred Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Insurance, or a related field.
  • Associate in Claims (AIC) designation.
  • Associate in General Insurance (AINS) designation.
  • CPCU coursework or other relevant insurance education or continuing professional development.

Salary Statement

The salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000.  

 

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.  Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. 

Benefits

West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including but not limited to:  

  • Medical & Prescription Insurance 
  • Health Savings Account 
  • Dental Insurance 
  • Vision Insurance 
  • Short and Long Term Disability 
  • Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Life and Accidental Death & Disability  
  • Accident and Critical Illness Insurance 
  • Employee Assistance Program 
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match 
  • Pet Insurance 
  • Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates
  • Bonus eligible based on performance 
  • West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies.

EEO

West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, and promotion.

You Matter

• Make a difference every day in the lives of the underserved• Join a mission driven organization with a people first culture• Excellent career growth opportunities

Join us and find a career that supports:• Caring for overlooked, underserved, and vulnerable patients• Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging• Autonomy in a warm team environment• Growth and training

Perks and Benefits In addition to comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, and 401k, we foster a work, life balance for team members and their family to support physical, mental, and financial wellbeing including: • DailyPay, receive your money as you earn it! • Tuition Assistance and dependent Scholarships• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including free counseling and health coaching• Company paid life insurance• Tax free Health Spending Accounts (HSA)• Wellness program featuring fitness memberships and product discounts• Preferred banking partnership and discounted rates for home and auto loans

*Eligibility for perks and benefits varies based on employee type and length of service.

Why Us

Now is your moment to make a difference in the lives of the underserved. If there is one unifying characteristic of everyone on our team, it is the deep desire to make a difference by helping society's most vulnerable and often overlooked individuals. Every day we have the distinct honor and responsibility to show up with non-judgmental compassion to provide hope and healing to those who need it most. For those whose calling it is to serve others, now is your moment to join our mission to provide quality care to every patient with compassion, collaboration, and innovation, to live our mantra to “Always Do The Right Thing!”, and to collectively do our part to heal the world, one patient at a time.

Wellpath sees hundreds of thousands of unique individuals in their facilities month over month and a very large percent of those individuals receive direct clinical care, which includes lives saved by Narcan.

We offer ongoing training and development opportunities for licensed and unlicensed healthcare team members, and have best in class clinical resources for training, education, and point of care support.

How you make a difference

The Licensed Practical Nurse Telehealth assists in delivering patient care through assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation under the supervision of a Registered Nurse. This role supports individualized treatment programs and guides patient teaching based on demonstrated competencies. The position assists onsite staff with remote access and virtual technology while providing care in accordance with established policies, procedures, and protocols. The Licensed Practical Nurse Telehealth also documents nursing encounters and communicates patient information to the appropriate healthcare team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with patient assessments, treatment planning, and patient teaching under the supervision of a Registered Nurse.
  • Implement individualized treatment programs and therapeutic diet plans as directed by the Health Care Practitioner.
  • Support onsite staff using remote access and virtual technology.
  • Provide clinical and technical care in accordance with established policies, procedures, protocols, and safety practices.
  • Document nursing encounters and communicate patient information to nursing staff, physicians, supervisory personnel, and other staff as necessary.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

  • Graduate from an accredited school of nursing.

Experience

  • Prefer a minimum of one (1) year correctional healthcare experience or
  • A minimum of one (1) year clinical experience.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Have and maintain current licensure as a Licensed Practical/Licensed Vocational Nurse within the state of employment.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain CPR certification.

This position is available only to those who reside in the United States.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of uniqueness.

We celebrate a variety of backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We encourage you to apply! If you are excited about a role but your experience doesn’t seem to align perfectly with every element of the job description, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this, or one of our many other roles.

Deadline to apply to this position is contingent upon applicant volume. Those positions located in Colorado will have a specific deadline posted in the job description.

We are an Affirmative Action Employer in accordance with applicable state and local laws.

raw.description:
Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization:

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Role Summary:

The Staff Accountant role at CDP offers a valuable opportunity to build accounting skills through hands-on experience and guidance from an experienced Finance team. With a primary focus on accounts payable and employee expense reporting, the selected candidate will gain exposure to the full accounting cycle, including billing, cash activity, reconciliations, month-end close, and audit support. Working with colleagues across departments, this person will learn how accounting connects to day-to-day business operations and develop broader responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. This role reports sits on the CDP Finance team and reports to the Senior Accountant.

Primary Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable:

  • Own and manage the Accounts Payable inbox and ensure invoices are processed accurately and timely.
  • Create and maintain vendor records, including new CDP employees when applicable, and collect required documentation such as W-9s and ACH/remittance information.
  • Maintain accurate vendor payment methods and remittance contacts, including ACH, credit card, and check information.
  • Maintain the current-year 1099 vendor/contractor listing and support annual 1099 preparation and processing.
  • Enter vendor invoices into Sage Intacct and route invoices to the appropriate CDP reviewer and approver.
  • Monitor Accounts Payable workflows and follow up with reviewers/approvers regarding outstanding invoices or approvals.
  • Communicate with vendors and CDP employees regarding missing invoices, out-of-pocket invoices, payment documentation, and other billing-related questions.
  • Access vendor portals and retrieve recurring or monthly invoices as needed.
  • Maintain a working understanding of general ledger expense accounts and appropriate P&L classifications.
  • Support monthly P&L reviews to identify missing expenses and potential accruals.
  • Maintain a working understanding of prepaid expense accounts and related balance sheet activity.
  • Support the review and reconciliation of prepaid expenses at month-end.
  • Support the monthly out-of-pocket (OOP) expense process.

Expense Reports & Corporate Credit Cards:

  • Support the monthly employee expense report process, including Expensify and corporate credit card activity, and verify that the vendor is populated on each expense when the system supports it.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding in Expensify and corporate credit card systems, including account setup, access changes, and coordination of card activation or cancellation as directed.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reminders to all staff regarding timely expense submission and approval.
  • Follow up with employees and approvers regarding outstanding or incomplete expense reports.
  • Perform the initial review of expense reports for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation. Route reports to the Manager for additional review, particularly during the first year; thereafter, follow review requirements and dollar thresholds established by Finance leadership.
  • Provide basic Expensify support and troubleshooting to employees when appropriate.
  • Assist with monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, including Visa, American Express, and Expensify activity.

Bank Statements and Reconciliation Support:

  • Provide bank statements and supporting documentation for monthly bank reconciliations. The Manager retains responsibility for preparing and reviewing bank reconciliations to maintain segregation of duties.
  • Research bank transactions and provide documentation to the Manager to help resolve reconciling items.
  • Maintain organized and accurate bank statement folders by account, month, and year.
  • Immediately escalate suspicious, unusual, or unidentified bank transactions to Finance leadership.

Other Duties:

  • Support ad hoc Finance and Accounting projects as needed.
  • Maintain organized, current, and accurate files and folders within the internal Finance drive.
  • Assist with expense and financial analysis when appropriate.
  • Support the year-end financial statement audit and related documentation requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, workflows, policies, and internal controls, and assist with documenting approved changes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other CDP departments as needed.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on Finance team needs, business priorities, and the employee’s demonstrated experience and development.

Preferred Qualifications:

Accounts Receivable & Billing:

  • Assist with preparing and issuing client invoices through Sage Intacct accurately and timely, and serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day billing inquiries.
  • Prepare, save, and maintain supporting invoice backup and PDF documentation when applicable.
  • Maintain current station Accounts Receivable contacts and applicable CDP contacts copied on invoices.
  • Maintain and update monthly and quarterly invoice-upload templates.
  • Assist with updating the MSB billing tracker for MSB, PS, and CRM services as needed. The Manager retains responsibility for reconciling the tracker to client agreements to confirm billing completeness and accuracy.
  • Update recurring invoicing information by station and product/service.
  • Add new MSB stations and update assigned Client Services representatives when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate license and email allotment information by station.
  • Monitor billing-related email, respond to routine questions, and collaborate with Station Finance and other internal teams. Escalate discrepancies, agreement questions, and unresolved issues to the Manager.
  • Assist with distributing Accounts Receivable aging statements to stations and supporting follow-up when appropriate.

Month-End Close:

  • Support completion of the monthly Finance close checklist and PS close checklist.
  • Prepare draft journal entries for prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned accounts.
  • Assist with preparing monthly OOP journal entries and station-level allocations.
  • Collaborate with MMT on station breakouts and supporting documentation when needed.
  • Assist with monthly account reconciliations for corporate cards, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned balance sheet accounts; provide supporting documentation for bank reconciliations performed by the Manager.

Systems and Experience:

  • Experience with Sage Intacct, Bank of America CashPro, and Expensify is a plus.

Commitment to Inclusion

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

  • DEI mindset: You embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
  • A Communicator: You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.
  • A Critical Thinker: You regularly look for ways to find efficiencies, innovate, and make improvements where you can.
  • Process Oriented:You’re able to understand, work in, create, and improve processes.
  • A Collaborator: You’re a team player willing to help where needed; a relationship builder whose can-do attitude inspires others; you actively share your job knowledge with team members.
  • Someone Who Seeks to Learn: You are eager to listen, study, and learn new things quickly; you are resourceful and are open to regularly accepting and growing from feedback.
  • Enterprising: You have proven success working in a fast-paced and changing environment; you have a strong work ethic and are excited to add value to the organization and its mission.

CDP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, nationality, immigration status, citizenship, religion or religious creed (or belief, where acceptable), sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, citizenship, marital status, handicap or disability, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), Veteran or military status, political belief, or socio-economic status. CDP does not discriminate against individuals on the basis of those characteristics or any other characteristic protected by law.

CDP provides reasonable accommodations for applicants with a disability in completing job application procedures. Please notify CDP Human Resources in advance so necessary arrangements can be made. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at .

raw.description:
Position Overview

Power Your Future with Qualus in our Transmission Line department as a Senior Manager of Engineering. The Senior Manager will own a number of critical business processes across Qualus' standard ownership domains. Ownership implies a responsibility for the proper and effective execution and management of business functions. Tasks related to the execution of these functions will likely be delegated to subordinate employees, however, the responsibility for the overall performance of owned functions falls directly on the Senior Manager of Engineering. This is a professional position responsible for managing, training, coordinating, and providing oversight of overhead transmission engineering. This position is also responsible for implementing best engineering methods, pursuing business development opportunities and maintaining good relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The role will provide technical guidance and management to engineering teams, supporting established organization objectives by developing goals and strategies, and overseeing group financials. The successful candidate will possess a broad, extensive, and deep understanding of both engineering principles and management practices and demonstrate the ability to apply that knowledge and experience to all aspects of operations.

Responsibilities

This is a professional position responsible for directing, training, coordinating, and providing oversight of engineering operations. This position is also responsible for implementing best engineering methods, pursuing business development opportunities and maintaining good relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Assignments will include providing technical guidance to engineering teams and top management, supporting established organization objectives by developing goals and strategies, and overseeing group financials. The successful candidate will possess a broad, extensive, and deep understanding of both engineering principles, business practices, and demonstrate the ability to apply that knowledge and experience to all aspects of operations. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Functional leader of service line
  • Responsible for service line financials
  • Maintains good relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Implements best practice engineering methods, develops training programs and performs training for service line employees
  • Interacts with other service lines to bid on and complete projects, cross train employees, share best practices
  • Responsible for technical performance of service line, provides technical guidance to engineering teams and top management
  • Support established organizational objectives by developing goals and strategies for service line
  • Create/develop drawing packages for bidding, construction, as-built, and submittal purposes
  • Ensure service line has tools to be successful: software, hardware, field, etc.
  • Adheres to and further develops company vision for entire service line
  • Shares responsibility for employee satisfaction and engagement
  • Finds and implements ways to improve cost-efficiency
  • Effective verbal and written communication including technical writing skills
  • Assists with the development and preparation of project scopes, budgets and schedules
  • Remain knowledgeable of development in regulations, laws, standards, and best practices applicable to our functional area, including but not limited to, Standards of Conduct, RUS Design Guidelines, the National Electric Safety Code, and General Order 95
  • Provide technical direction and assistance to others, as required
  • Sets engineering policy and practices to be implemented company wide and ensures that QA/QC policies are adhered to
  • Provides support to business development or pursuit activities

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or other similarly related engineering disciplines
  • Registered as a Professional Engineer
  • Ten (10) or more years of experience in engineering, preferably related to utility infrastructure design, including a minimum of three (3) years of management experience leading engineering teams
  • Extensive and thorough knowledge of engineering design for service line and related fields
  • Advanced knowledge of applicable design software
  • Advanced knowledge of engineering principles and practices, including computer applications
  • Extensive knowledge of field techniques for construction
  • Extensive knowledge of surveying techniques, practices, and procedures
  • Extensive knowledge of safe working practices related to electric transmission lines

raw.excerpt: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.
  • Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack
  • Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.
  • Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.
  • Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.


What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation
  • Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.
  • Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.
  • Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).
  • Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.
  • Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.


Nice to have

  • Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.
  • Reverse engineering and exploits development experience
  • Application security experience
  • Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.
  • Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.
  • Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).
  • Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.


Why this role at Nebius

  • Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Overview

The Senior Cloud Architect establishes and maintains NASCO’s AWS cloud environment to ensure security, scalability, operational resilience, and streamlined design across our SaaS product architectures. This role leads cloud architectural direction, engages in governance, ensures alignment with AWS best practices, and collaborates with engineering, product, security, and cloud operations teams. The Senior Cloud Architect translates complex requirements into actionable designs while promoting innovation, cost efficiency, and technical excellence across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Guides the design, development, and deployment of cloud‑native, elastic, resilient SaaS products aligned to AWS best practices
  • Architects secure, scalable, performant, serverless SaaS solutions ensuring high availability
  • Defines and maintains cloud architecture standards, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns using primarily AWS resources
  • Creates and maintains architectural blueprints for infrastructure, applications, and data flows
  • Establishes and enforces cloud governance frameworks, usage guardrails, and design principles
  • Ensures compliance with SOC 2, HIPAA, and other regulatory and security frameworks
  • Guides adoption of Infrastructure‑as‑Code and automation to streamline provisioning, configuration, and operations
  • Guides adoption of optimized CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to improve deployment automation and delivery efficiency
  • Enforces cloud security best practices including IAM, network segmentation, encryption, and secure SaaS product design
  • Develops and guides cloud observability strategies and optimize AWS environments for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency
  • Mentors architects and engineers, and leads governance reviews to ensure scalable, secure, strategically aligned financially responsible design
  • Partners with product management, engineering, cloud operations, architecture, and security teams to communicate decisions and align cloud implementation with enterprise goals

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing large‑scale SaaS solutions on AWS
  • Deep expertise in AWS cloud architecture across compute, storage, networking, integration, and serverless design
  • Proficiency in cloud‑native design patterns, microservices, and event‑driven architectures
  • Advanced knowledge of cloud security (IAM, encryption, secure design) and compliance frameworks
  • Strong experience with IaC tools such as CloudFormation or Terraform and modern DevOps practices
  • Skilled in observability tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities with experience resolving complex issues in a cloud environment
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder‑engagement skills
  • Demonstrated leadership ability and experience mentoring technical teams
  • Ability to operate across multiple projects and operate effectively in a fast‑paced commercial SaaS environment

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of cloud governance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks or NIST
  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities on AWS, including Bedrock

  • Knowledge of AWS Well Architected Framework and ability to apply those principles to SaaS design reviews
  • Experience in forecasting design cloud compute costs, FinOps processes and design-based financial impacts

Experience:

  • 10 years in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, or solution architecture
  • 5 years hands‑on experience with AWS and cloud‑native commercial SaaS products
  • 5 years of experience in designing complex distributed systems and enterprise cloud solutions

Required Training, Certification and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • AWS Solutions Architect – Professional Certification or similar

Preferred Training, Certification and Education:

  • Master’s degree in a technology‑related field

Working Conditions:

Benefits Overview

At NASCO, we trust our workforce to be fully remote, working from their home. This benefit offers significant, personalized outcomes for each associate including work/life balance, savings on commuting, work clothing, and increased time to spend on personal activities.

Our full benefit package is designed to support the physical, mental, and financial health of our associates. We offer:

  • Generous PTO with buy/sell options

  • Bonus and Recognition programs

  • Consultation with financial planner
  • Basic Life & AD&D Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance provided, and Supplemental Term Life Insurance is available
  • Group Discount programs - mobile, technology services, etc., to help you save money

Other Benefits

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other grounds, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, protected veteran status or status as an individual with a disability.
