Serves as a technical liaison with the client and a lead technical resource on projects. Lead engineers support engineering design projects. You will work with a structural engineering team on engineering projects for new nuclear facilities and upgrades and modifications to nuclear power plants and other safety-related structures in the following areas:

  • This position will offer you the ability to directly apply your knowledge of materials, structural analysis, structural steel design, and reinforced concrete design
  • As a member of an engineering and design team, you will work on a wide range of projects for various clients. You will prepare design calculations, develop specifications, and support designers with drawing development. You will also have the opportunity to guide others in the development of engineering deliverables.
  • Using our state-of-the-art computer tools, you will perform the structural analysis of safety-related structures under various loading conditions, such seismic loading, impactive/impulsive loading.
  • There is the potential for you to travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for construction coordination and field verification of designs

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential skills and experience:

  • MS degree in Civil Engineering with an emphasis in Structural Engineering from an ABET-accredited program
  • Five or more years of experience working as a member of a project team in the design and analysis of structures
  • Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000, STRUDL, SASSI, ANSYS, or LS-DYNA
  • Proficiency with analysis and design codes and standards such as ASCE 4, ASCE 43, ASCE 7, AISC, and ACI
  • Working knowledge of structural design and assessment for blast loads using single-degree-of-freedom tools, including SBEDS, in accordance with UFC 3-340-02 and Protective Design Center (PDC) guidelines.
  • Experience designing and assessing structures subjected to explosive loading using explicit dynamic analysis in LS-DYNA.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills

Valued, but not required:

  • Ph.D. degree
  • Experience with design and analysis of power plant and/or industrial structures
  • On site construction support experience
  • PE or SE license

AI & Automation at Sargent & Lundy

In this role, we expect people to be willing or able to lead others who use modern tools:

  • You are expected to lead others in taking engineering problems from issue to solution by setting expectations for using data and modern tools such as automation and AI to improve workflows, reduce rework, and deliver cost-effective designs.
  • Leaders in these roles often direct automation and process-improvement work, for example, how teams automate calculations, summarize technical documents, or generate design documentation and guiding when and how AI or agentic AI tools are used while ensuring results are checked.
  • Overseeing engineers who program or script (e.g., Python, MATLAB, advanced Excel) to automate engineering tasks, with review of automated outputs, is valued but not required.
  • We also value additional learning, such as a minor, certificate, or other experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or related fields that enables effective oversight of automation and agentic AI-enabled engineering workflows.

Award-Winning Benefits

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Join Sargent & Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon-free energy. Position Summary

The Client Services Representative 2 is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of pharmaceutical sales representative drug sample inventories through detailed reconciliation, investigation, and resolution of inventory variances. This role requires strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to effectively communicate with pharmaceutical sales representatives, client stakeholders, and vendors. The successful candidate will provide outstanding customer service, maintain compliance with established processes, and serve as a trusted partner in resolving complex inventory and sampling discrepancies.


Major Responsibilities

  • Investigate, analyze, and reconcile pharmaceutical sales representative drug sample inventory discrepancies, including returns, disbursements, shipments, transfers, and other sampling transactions.
  • Conduct detailed research to identify root causes of variances and ensure timely and accurate resolution.
  • Communicate professionally, both verbally and in writing, with sales representatives, client home office personnel, and third-party vendors to resolve discrepancies and address inventory-related inquiries.
  • Build and maintain positive working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders by providing responsive, solutions-oriented service.
  • Prepare and present written analyses, supporting documentation, and system-generated reports to management and clients, clearly outlining findings and recommendations.
  • Review, validate, and maintain inventory-related records to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company and client requirements.
  • Perform administrative functions, including data entry, document management, scanning, filing, and quality review of supporting documentation.
  • Identify trends or recurring issues within reconciliation activities and escalate concerns as appropriate.
  • Support team initiatives, process improvements, and cross-functional projects to enhance operational effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with team members to meet service level expectations and departmental goals.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex discrepancies.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when reviewing data, documentation, and transaction records.
  • Experience working with large datasets, including sorting, analyzing, manipulating, and presenting information to support decision-making.
  • Proven ability to identify inconsistencies, perform detailed audits, and ensure data integrity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across varying levels of an organization.
  • Experience interacting directly with clients, customers, or external stakeholders in a professional service-oriented environment.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to manage sensitive conversations, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities, manage multiple tasks simultaneously, and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle information with discretion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in inventory reconciliation, compliance reporting, auditing, financial operations, pharmaceutical operations, or a related analytical field.
  • Experience supporting client-facing programs or working in a regulated environment where accuracy and documentation are critical.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, filtering, pivot tables, and reporting.

An overview of the role

As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).

What you’ll do

  • Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.
  • Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.
  • Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.
  • Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.
  • Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.
  • Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.
  • Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.
  • Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.
  • Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.
  • Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.
  • Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.
  • Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.
  • Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.
  • Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.

About the team

Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.

Who is BAMKO?

BAMKO is one of the top 10 largest companies in the branded merchandise space and the fastest growing of any of the top 50 companies in the $25 billion dollar industry. Over the last 5 years, BAMKO has won countless awards, including Best Places to Work & Best Client Promotions. With a culture built around the concepts of personal and professional growth, BAMKO puts values into actions. BAMKO has the best and the brightest employees who love a challenge that unlocks their highest potential. Our portfolio of clients have a range of known Fortune 1000 companies. This includes but is not limited to Dunkin’ Donuts, Tesla, Microsoft, Peloton and more! We are a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and innovative company where culture is at our core. We attract and retain high-level talent that continues to outpace the competition. If you are driven, have big brain ideas, are competitive and enjoy working with multiple teams, we want you to be a part of building something special here at BAMKO.

BAMKO is looking for a detail-driven Project Manager to run overseas promotional product and merchandise programs for some of our largest retail, consumer and enterprise clients. You'll be the US point person between our sales team, clients, and our sourcing and production teams in Asia. You'll own each order from RFP and quoting through production, QC, freight and final delivery. We'll hire at the Project Manager or Senior Project Manager level, depending on experience.

What YOU will do:

  • Manage a portfolio of active projects and orders across several major accounts, from five-figure samples to multimillion-dollar programs
  • Work daily with our Asia operations teams and outside brokers on quotes, samples, production timelines and problems as they come up
  • Lead RFP responses: gather specs, collect pricing from factories and brokers, and build quotes that hit margin targets
  • Check art, proofs, Pantone/PMS colors and packaging specs before production so mistakes are caught early
  • Coordinate freight, DDP and drop-ship deliveries, and in-hand dates across multiple distribution centers and warehouses
  • Keep clients and sales reps up to date on status, risks and changes
  • Work with accounting and AP on client billing, vendor payments, POs, and duties and tariff questions
  • Keep project trackers accurate, and close orders out after delivery

Who YOU are:

  • 3–5+ years of project management, production or sourcing experience in promotional products, consumer goods or apparel; Senior level typically [6+] years
  • Experience working with overseas factories or sourcing teams in Asia
  • Strong organization: you can run 30+ live projects without dropping details
  • Clear, confident communication with clients, sales and international teammates
  • Comfort with numbers: costing, margins, freight
  • Working knowledge of imports, tariffs and logistics (a plus)
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel; ERP or order system experience is a plus

Why BAMKO?

The rate of pay offered will be dependent upon the candidate’s relevant skills and experience. In addition, there a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, various paid time off programs, and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

raw.description:
The Sr. Vice President, Head of System Integrators and Channel Sales a senior commercial leader responsible for defining, building, and scaling Sapiens’ global SI and channel ecosystem to drive sustainable revenue growth, market coverage, and execution leverage. This role owns the SI and channel strategy end-to-end – from partner segmentation and value proposition to execution discipline, governance, and measurable outcomes – ensuring channels operate as a system-led growth engine rather than a collection of ad-hoc relationships.

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role partners closely with Sales, Product, Services, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional leadership to build repeatable partner motions that increase pipeline, win rate, and long-term customer value in a complex enterprise SaaS environment.

Job Responsibilities

Channel / SI Strategy & Operating Model:
  • Define and own the global SI & channel strategy, including partner types, coverage models, segmentation, and prioritization.
  • Design a clear channel operating model with rules of engagement, governance, incentives, and success metrics.
  • Establish clarity on where channels lead, where direct sales lead, and where joint motion applies.

Partner Ecosystem Development:
  • Build and scale a focused, tiered partner ecosystem including strategic alliances, systems integrators, regional partners, and technology partners.
  • Recruit, onboard, and enable partners with clear expectations, joint business plans, and performance standards.
  • Drive partner specialization by region, vertical, and solution to increase win rates and delivery success.

Revenue Ownership & Performance Management:
  • Own channel-sourced and channel-influenced pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Establish forecasting discipline, partner scorecards, and KPI dashboards.
  • Optimize partner productivity, deal quality, and repeatability of outcomes.

Partner Enablement & Experience:
  • Build scalable partner onboarding, training, certifications, and sales enablement programs.
  • Enable internal sales teams to consistently and effectively co-sell with partners.
  • Ensure a frictionless partner experience through clear processes and fast decision-making.

Channel Programs & Governance:
  • Design and operate partner programs including tiering, incentives, and deal registration.
  • Establish governance mechanisms that reduce channel conflict and improve transparency.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, and RevOps to ensure compliance and clean execution.

Cross-Functional GTM Orchestration:
  • Align with regional sales leadership on territory coverage, account mapping, and partner engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product and Services to ensure partner-sold deals are deliverable and scalable.
  • Work with Marketing on partner-driven demand generation and co-marketing initiatives.

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in SI, Channel Sales, Alliances, or Partner Ecosystems within B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
  • Proven experience building and scaling global partner programs in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong track record owning revenue outcomes through indirect channels.
  • Executive presence and ability to influence cross-functionally.
  • Proven experience developing and deploying global strategies as it relates to Channel & SI partnerships
  • East Coast candidates highly preferred

Founded in 1993, Prominence Health started as a health maintenance organization (HMO) and was acquired by a subsidiary of Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS) in 2014. Prominence Health serves members, physicians, and health systems across Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Accountable Care Organizations, and commercial payer partnerships. Prominence Health is committed to transforming healthcare delivery by improving health outcomes while controlling costs and enhancing the patient experience. Learn more at: Job Summary: The Senior Manager of Product Development is pivotal to guiding our product strategy by orchestrating collaboration with business leaders, technical teams, actuarial stakeholders, and external partners. The role demands expertise in advancing product design based on market analysis, aligning with the company’s strategic goals, ensuring adherence to regulatory timelines for product filings, and staying updated with ever-evolving industry trends. This role calls for development, organization, and facilitation of Prominence Health Plan's commercial and Medicare Advantage products, system and infrastructure improvements, and vendor selection and implementation. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Senior Manager will provide essential support to the organizational business teams in the development, implementation, and compliance of new and renewing commercial and Medicare clients, products, and vendors. Responsibilities encompass three core components of the job: Program Delivery Bid and AEP Project Management Product Analysis Product Insights and Market Intelligence Tracking financial and growth impact of benefit changes CMS/Regulatory Deliverables Regulatory Submissions SNP Model of care management This role will provide crucial support to the organizational business teams in the development, implementation, and compliance of new and renewing commercial and Medicare clients, products, and vendors. In the tactical layer, this role will work directly with internal and external customers to initiate, plan, execute and manage product development and implementation initiatives to accomplish overall business, client, and vendor objectives. In the strategic layer, the Senior Manager is responsible for working with Sales and our executive team on competitive positioning, growth objectives, and plan optimization. title: Technical Project Manager
description: Productiv Team is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across product and engineering teams.

raw.title: Technical Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Productiv Team is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across product and engineering teams.
raw.description:
Productiv Team is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead complex technology initiatives across product and engineering teams. Candidate will provide hands-on delivery leadership, coordinating people, plans, dependencies, risks, and decisions to move initiatives from definition through implementation and release.
The Ideal candidate combines strong project management fundamentals with enough technical fluency to work effectively with software engineering, architecture, quality assurance, DevOps, product, and business stakeholders. This is an execution-focused role requiring independent ownership, sound judgment, proactive communication, and the ability to maintain delivery momentum across multiple teams.

How You’ll Add Value

You will help ensure that strategic technology initiatives are clearly planned, well-coordinated, and delivered predictably. You will connect product priorities with engineering execution, surface issues early, facilitate timely decisions, and provide stakeholders with an accurate view of progress, risks, and outcomes. You will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, technical leads, and business partners while respecting the distinct responsibilities of each role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Project and Delivery Management

  • Lead multiple high-visibility technology initiatives from planning and initiation through execution, implementation, release, and post-implementation review.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, budgets (where applicable), and delivery forecasts.
  • Translate strategic commitments and business objectives into actionable delivery plans aligned with product roadmaps, sprint plans, and release schedules.
  • Coordinate scope definition, requirements, readiness, solution/design reviews, estimates, sequencing, and delivery dependencies.
  • Partner with Product Owners to clarify priorities, manage scope, assess trade-offs, and keep delivery aligned with business value and agreed outcomes.
  • Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify schedule, resource, scope, and quality variances; develop mitigation and recovery plans as needed.

Cross-Team Coordination and Dependency Management

  • Coordinate work across multiple Agile pods and technology teams, ensuring cross-team dependencies, handoffs, and integration points are identified and actively managed.
  • Work with Scrum Masters, who manage pod-level ceremonies and blockers, to address initiative-level risks, issues, and dependencies that span teams.
  • Facilitate collaboration among engineering, architecture, QA, DevOps, product, vendors, and business stakeholders to resolve impediments and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Coordinate technical decision-making and escalation paths, ensuring decisions, owners, and due dates are clear and documented.
  • Support release planning with technical leads, including environment readiness, integration sequencing, deployment dependencies, and go/no-go preparation.

Risk, Issue, and Stakeholder Management

  • Own initiative-level risk and issue management, maintaining risk registers, action logs, decision logs, and mitigation plans.
  • Identify emerging delivery concerns early, assess impact and likelihood, recommend options, and drive resolution with accountable owners.
  • Provide concise, accurate, and timely status reporting for leadership and stakeholders, including milestones, accomplishments, upcoming work, dependencies, decisions, and risks.
  • Prepare and facilitate project reviews, steering discussions, stakeholder updates, and escalation meetings.
  • Manage expectations transparently and communicate changes to scope, timeline, priorities, or delivery forecasts.

Quality, Release, and Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, defect triage, readiness reviews, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Partner with QA and engineering leads to ensure test planning quality gates, and release criteria are incorporated into delivery plans.
  • Coordinate implementation activities and post-release follow-up, including issue tracking, operational handoff, and lessons learned.
  • Promote consistent project management practices, lightweight governance, and continuous improvement without adding unnecessary process overhead.
  • Use approved AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve planning, analysis, documentation, and communication, consistent with organizational policies.

Vendor and Governance Management

  • Coordinate external vendors and consultants, monitor commitments and deliverables, and address delivery concerns in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
  • Track budgets, contracts, resource commitments, and vendor performance where applicable.
  • Ensure project activities account for security, privacy, data governance, compliance, and organizational standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex technology projects or programs involving software development teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, Scrum, iterative planning, and modern software release practices.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across engineering, product, QA, architecture, DevOps, and business functions.
  • Ability to independently own initiatives, establish structure, drive actions to completion, and maintain delivery momentum with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, responsive, and comfortable anticipating challenges and addressing issues before they affect delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear executive updates and facilitate effective meetings and presentations.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with people across roles and levels.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-facilitation skills.
  • Experience with project management tools and documentation, such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to work Monday through Friday and maintain availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or other relevant project/program management or Agile certifications.
  • Experience with scaled Agile delivery Scrum of Scrums, Kanban, or coordination across multiple Agile pods.
  • Technical familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, databases, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, budgets, contracts, and external delivery partners.
  • Experience planning and coordinating UAT campaigns, enterprise implementations, and production releases.
  • Experience establishing PMO practices, delivery standards, dashboards, and project governance.
  • Familiarity with AI tools that support project planning, reporting, analysis, and documentation.
  • Experience working in mission-driven, nonprofit, sustainability, or green building organizations.

Education


Bachelors degree in Computer Science Information Technology, Project Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Engagement Details

  • Work schedule: Monday–Friday, with availability during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours. The candidate must be available for scheduled project meetings, stakeholder discussions, delivery reviews, and cross-team coordination during ET working hours.
  • Reporting to: Manager, Technology Application Delivery
The candidate is expected to demonstrate consistent availability, respond promptly, communicate proactively, and take ownership of assigned initiatives and deliverables. The successful candidate will independently drive project activities, follow through on commitments, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and decisions.

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

raw.description:
AECOM is seeking a Junior Fire Protection Engineer, Data Centers to join our growing Data Center Practice. Working under the supervision of a Senior Fire Protection Engineer, this junior-level role will support the design and delivery of fire protection and life safety systems for data center and closely related mission critical projects, including fire suppression, fire alarm, mass notification, code and egress analysis, special-hazard evaluation, multidisciplinary coordination, and construction-phase support. Candidates should have relevant fire protection engineering experience and working knowledge of applicable building, fire, life safety, and NFPA standards. Direct data center experience is preferred but not required for candidates with strong, transferable mission critical experience.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote or hybrid work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Travel to client meetings, project sites, and AECOM offices may be required based on assignment. Travel is typically scheduled in advance.

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work under the supervision and technical direction of a Senior Fire Protection Engineer to deliver assigned fire protection and life safety tasks.
  • Develop fire suppression, fire alarm, and mass notification system designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, narratives, and reports.
  • Perform life safety code analysis, occupancy and construction-type evaluations, means-of-egress calculations, and related code documentation.
  • Support performance-based design, fire and smoke modeling, and egress modeling under senior technical oversight.
  • Evaluate battery, fuel, generator, electrical, and other special hazards and assist in developing fire risk mitigation strategies for mission critical facilities.
  • Coordinate fire protection requirements with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, security, telecommunications, civil, and other disciplines.
  • Use Revit and AutoCAD to develop and coordinate design documents in accordance with project and practice standards.
  • Participate in project meetings, design reviews, quality-control reviews, and coordination workshops; document and resolve assigned technical comments.
  • Support project work planning by tracking assigned scope, schedule, level of effort, deliverables, and emerging technical or coordination issues.
  • Assist with construction administration, including review of submittals, responses to requests for information, site observations, and resolution of field conditions.
  • Coordinate with authorities having jurisdiction and support preparation of code interpretations, permit responses, and alternate-method documentation under senior guidance.
  • Contribute to proposals, fee estimates, staffing plans, technical presentations, and qualifications materials for data center and mission critical pursuits.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable codes, standards, design tools, and emerging fire protection issues affecting data center facilities.
  • Provide technical guidance to entry-level engineers and designers when assigned, while escalating significant technical decisions to the Senior Fire Protection Engineer.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Fire Protection Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited university.
  • Foundational understanding of fire suppression, fire alarm, mass notification, and life safety design documents.
  • Foundational understanding of life safety code analysis and egress analysis.
  • Foundational understanding of fire modeling, smoke modeling, egress modeling, performance-based design, or special-hazard analysis.
  • Knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and commonly applied NFPA standards.
  • Experience using Revit and AutoCAD in a coordinated design environment.
  • Ability to produce clear calculations, drawings, specifications, reports, and technical correspondence under senior review.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, respond to review comments, and elevate risks or technical questions promptly.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 1 year of professional engineering experience in fire protection and life safety design for building projects, including experience on complex or mission critical facilities.
  • Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction or demonstrated progress toward licensure.
  • Experience developing fire suppression, fire alarm, mass notification, and life safety design documents.
  • Experience performing life safety code analysis and egress analysis.
  • Experience with fire modeling, smoke modeling, egress modeling, performance-based design, or special-hazard analysis.
  • Working knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and commonly applied NFPA standards.
  • Direct experience supporting fire protection design for data centers, colocation facilities, hyperscale campuses, or other related facilities.
  • Mission critical project experience involving high availability, operational continuity, phased construction, or fast-track delivery.
  • Experience evaluating lithium-ion batteries, battery energy storage systems, emergency and standby power systems, fuel storage and distribution, or similar special hazards.
  • Experience supporting permitting and coordination with authorities having jurisdiction.
  • Experience providing construction-phase services and participating in commissioning or integrated systems testing.
  • Graduate of an ABET-accredited Fire Protection Engineering program.
  • Active participation in SFPE, NFPA, or another relevant professional organization.
  • US Citizenship
  • Proximity to the Washington DC area.
  • Relocation is not available for this role.
  • Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY FEBRUARY, 01, 2027

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Standard Job Description

Functional Architect - Product Lifecycle Enablement

The Product Lifecycle Enablement organization is responsible for Enterprise PLM capabilities and processes, Engineering data strategy and implementation, and establishing common ontology & interfaces that enable 1LMX Digital Thread and embedded Al solutions.​

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you will be accountable for overall system architecture and functional processes. Primary responsibilities include the following:

  • Manage overall functional requirements baseline and process definition
  • Acts as the technical authority, bridging complex business processes across the product lifecycle
  • Lead requirements traceability, verification, and change-control discipline for scope
  • Collaborating with senior stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate complex business requirements into business system solutions and functional requirements
  • Provide guidance and feedback to development teams during capability development and implementation

Further Information About This Opportunity:
This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to program requirements.

Designs, develops and oversees system architectures, including complex systems and systems design activities. Serves as focal point for the development and communication of the system architecture. Ensures conversion of mission requirements into total systems solutions that account for design and technology maturity constraints of the system. Develops systems and system element architecture, design, and interface definition. Supports internal and external design reviews. Maintains knowledge of current and developing technologies and design and analysis methodologies. Develops models and architectural guidelines for current and future system development.

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated knowledge of product lifecycle management processes, including bill of material generation, process planning, CAD, and configuration management.
  • Experience with Dassault 3DX, PTC Windchill, and/or Siemens Teamcenter
  • Demonstrated knowledge of model-based engineering and system architecture
  • Experience supporting enterprise software implementation or digital transformation
  • Demonstrated knowledge of systems-engineering governance, process definition, process implementation, and continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience.
  • US Citizenship is required due to program requirements

Desired Skills

  • Demonstrated success in implementing process improvements
  • Experience with requirements-management and process modeling tools such as DOORS and Signavio
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organization boundaries to leverage best practices and share assets
  • Experience in systems engineering, requirements management, or governance functions
  • Ability to manage ambiguous or competing requirements, collaborating with project teams to align on solutions.

Pay Information

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $133500.00 - $247900.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

Solutions Engineer – U.S. Public Sector

About Arango:

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens,, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Arango is a proud member of the NVIDIA Inception Program and the AWS ISV Accelerate Program. Learn more at,LinkedIn, andG2.

The Mission (About the Role)

We are seeking a highly technical Solutions Engineer to join our U.S. Public Sector organization. This is a high-impact role focused on driving technical adoption across U.S. Public Sector Accounts. The ideal candidate understands that "U.S. Public Sector" isn't just a vertical, it’s a unique ecosystem with complex security requirements, air-gapped environments, and high-stakes requirements. You will serve as the technical authority, translating Arango’s "Silicon Valley" innovation into "Mission-Ready" solutions. Whether you are a transitioning military member (Cyber/Intel), a career GovCon Architect, or a Data Scientist, if you thrive on solving "no-fail" problems, we want you on the team.

Location: Washington, DC / Northern Virginia (NCR) (preferred) but open to other areas of federal concentration localities.

Clearance: Preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Architect Mission Solutions: Craft and deliver technical presentations and architecturally sound demonstrations of the Arango Platform, tailored to specific agency use cases (e.g., Target Intelligence, Fraud/Waste/Abuse, Supply Chain Risk).
  • Lead Technical Evaluations: Drive Proof of Concepts/Technology (PoCs/PoTs) within secure environments, often comparing Arango against legacy NoSQL or relational databases.

What Makes Arango Special?

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.

Working at Arango means:

  • Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
  • Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
  • Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications

If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.
  • Experience mentoring developers on unit testing, testability, and quality-engineering practices.
  • Experience testing applications deployed across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Experience testing complex integrations, asynchronous workflows, file movement, databases, messaging, and distributed application components.
  • Familiarity with observability tools, logging, monitoring, dashboards, and test reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and operational teams

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $90,000 - $105,000

We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing .

For LA County and City Residents Only: NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. As a key client-facing role, the CSM will serve as the strategic partner and main point of contact for our advertising clients, ensuring they derive maximum value from our services and campaigns. raw.description:
Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead

Georgia Center for Opportunity (GCO) is an independent, non-partisan policy research organization that develops solutions leading to social and economic opportunity in the state of Georgia and beyond. Our vision is to make vibrant communities where everyone can achieve their potential.

Our mission is to empower families to flourish across generations. We advance solutions that increase opportunity and create durable pathways to prosperity for Georgia’s families. To achieve our mission, we research ways to help remove barriers to opportunity in each of these pathways, promote our solutions to policymakers and the public, and help effective and innovative social enterprises deliver results in their communities. Our ultimate goal is to see every Georgian who is willing to seize the opportunities presented to them living a life that can be characterized as truly flourishing.

GCO is poised for growth. With an office in Peachtree Corners and programs in Gwinnett County and Columbus, Georgia, GCO is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative environment. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead must be a self-starter, an independent worker, and a team player in this fast-growing organization.

This role reports to the Vice President of Program Strategy & Impact. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality coaching and facilitation across the organization's partner network. This role develops the practice standards, training systems, coaching frameworks, and quality assurance processes that make transformational coaching teachable, repeatable, and effective.

Working closely with internal teams, partners, and volunteers, this position equips facilitators and other volunteers with the knowledge, tools, and confidence needed to deliver an exceptional participant experience. The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead also serves as the primary resource for advanced coaching guidance for partner organizations, helping partners navigate complex situations while maintaining fidelity to the program's coaching philosophy.

The Practice & Coaching Excellence Lead is responsible for establishing and maintaining program standards for high-quality coaching and facilitation in the classroom, including volunteer competencies, practice indicators, and quality assurance processes. The role supports the observation and assessment of frontline practice, provides targeted feedback and coaching to support classroom performance, and partners with internal team members and partners to address practice gaps and implement improvement plans. The Lead ensures that new frameworks, training, and tools are effectively adopted in the field while balancing program fidelity with appropriate contextual adaptation. This role also coordinates, facilitates, and oversees formal certification processes for the partner's volunteer coaches (Champions) and facilitators.

This role continuously evaluates coaching effectiveness by collecting and reviewing participant and partner feedback, identifying opportunities for improvement, and translating those insights into stronger training and coaching practices.

While most training and consultation can be delivered virtually, this position may require some travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously improve the organization's coaching philosophy, competencies, and practice standards that reinforce best practices.
  • Ensure coaching excellence is accessible, teachable, and repeatable throughout the network.
  • Foster psychologically safe learning environments where volunteers continue developing their skills.
  • Develop clear coaching models that ensure consistent participant experiences across all partner sites.
  • Translate behavioral science and evidence-based coaching practices into simple, practical tools.
  • Design and deliver engaging training for staff, partners, facilitators, and volunteer coaches.
  • Equip partner organizations to confidently deliver high-quality coaching that directly supports participants in the classroom.
  • Serve as the primary coaching consultant for partners facing complex participant or graduate situations.
  • Establish quality standards and observation processes for coaching and facilitation during new partner onboarding.
  • Evaluate participant and partner surveys to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Recommend and implement improvements that strengthen participant outcomes and coaching consistency.
  • Collaborate with program leadership to refine training materials and implementation strategies when needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in education, social work, organizational development, psychology, human services, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Five or more years of experience in coaching, adult learning, workforce development, leadership development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering adult learning programs.
  • Experience coaching professionals or training facilitators.
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to interpret partner and participant feedback provided and translate insights into practical improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional coaching certification or equivalent coaching experience.
  • Experience with motivational interviewing, advancement coaching, trauma-informed coaching, or other evidence-based coaching models.
  • Experience supporting nonprofit or community-based partner organizations.
  • Experience developing quality assurance systems and performance standards.

Compensation & Benefits

GCO offers a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, and provides excellent benefits: health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, a 401k plan, life insurance, and paid time off. This position also offers the right candidate significant opportunities for professional development and growth.

We are looking for people who share our values of innovation, passion, excellence, and impact. For more on GCO, go to www.foropportunity.org.

About the Finance team

Our team manages financial planning, accounting, pricing, vendor management, tax, investor relations, and corporate development. We deliver timely insights, accurate reporting, and careful analysis to support decision-making. From day-to-day financial operations to major investments, we enable sustainable, informed growth by maintaining strong fiscal discipline.

About the role

We are looking for a proactive and experienced individual to join as Affirm Bank Treasury Manager. As Affirm Bank is currently in its formation phase, we are actively building out our foundational team. Reporting to the Bank CFO, Bank Treasury is responsible for cash management and operations, funding and liquidity planning, and balance sheet risk management for Affirm Bank. As we continue to scale the Bank and build out the foundational team, the ideal candidate should be able to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced environment with an eagerness to learn and grow.

What you’ll do

  • Support all treasury-related functions with a focus on liquidity and funding risk management, cash management, and periodic funding planning
  • Develop and execute liquidity risk stress testing models, defining stress scenarios, identifying risk exposures, and calibrating underlying model assumptions
  • Develop and maintain the Contingency Funding Plan (CFP), lead CFP simulations and testing, and track action plan timelines for liquidity events
  • Maintain and review Early Warning Indicators (EWIs) and existing risk limits, recommending updates and enhancements to balance sheet risk tolerances
  • Support The Asset Liability Committee (ALCO) reporting and committee presentations under the Bank CFO, benchmarking liquidity and Interest Rate Risk (IRR) profiles against limits
  • Support quarterly Interest Rate Risk (IRR) stress tests and semi-annual back-testing results reviews for ALCO
  • Assist with annual policy and assumption reviews, policy exception documentation, and recordkeeping for Liquidity and IRR policies
  • Guide the enhancement of balance sheet risk management reporting analytics and monitoring for senior leadership, regulators, and internal partners
  • Work cross-functionally with Affirm Treasury, Capital Markets, Bank Engineering, Strategic Finance, and the Bank Controller / Record to Report teams

What we look for

  • 5+ years of treasury or related financial function experience within banking or financial services
  • BA/BS required
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) preferred
  • Broad range of Treasury specific experience with both market facing and risk management exposure at a financial institution and have familiarity with consumer deposits, working capital line, warehouse facilities and other typical financial funding instruments

raw.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

Misumi Americas is seeking a Senior Applications Engineer - CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high-complexity, production-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD&T, and DFM skills,strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer & Program/Production Support

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs.
  • Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions.
  • Some level of support for customers through prototype → production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early.

Manufacturing & DFM Expertise

  • Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC-machined components.
  • Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost.
  • Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling.
  • Support efforts with manufacturing-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time.

Assembly & System-Level Understanding/Support

  • Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including:
    • Part-to-part fit, stack-ups, and tolerance interactions
    • Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly
    • Assembly sequencing and installation considerations
  • Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation.
  • Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework.

Technical Execution

  • Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD&T.
  • Perform CAD work, including:
    • Design updates for manufacturability
    • Parametric 3D Modeling & Visualization
    • Detailed Documentation & Drafting with GD&T
    • Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM
    • Reverse engineering
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams.

Quality & Compliance Awareness

  • Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows.
  • Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition (“quality in, quality out”).

Desired Traits

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply).
  • Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands-on experience.
  • Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi-axis) and Casting, .
  • Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade-off fluency.
  • Hands-on experience in production-scale manufacturing programs.
  • Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical discussions.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.
  • Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills.
  • SolidWorks CAD proficiency.
  • Willingness to perform hands-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed.
  • Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with Casting, Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP).
  • Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers.
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer-facing content creation, and day-to-day engineering workflows.
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer-facing workflows.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Standard Office & Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations.
  • Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection).
  • Lifting & Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K plan
  • Parental leave programs
  • Paid volunteer days
  • And much, much more!

Salary Range: $175,000 to $180,000 per year, based upon experience

Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

raw.description:
Manager, EMEA Enterprise Support

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the Director, Enterprise Support | Remote, EMEA-based

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Backblaze is growing quickly, with customers that include some of the biggest AI, media, and cloud infrastructure companies in the world. As our EMEA business grows, we are investing in a dedicated, in-region Enterprise Support team, and we need a Manager to build it and lead it. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Support, you will help shape how we support strategic customers in the region, with the speed, depth, and care that enterprise teams expect.

You will hire and develop the team, set the standards, and grow the operation, in close partnership with Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Engineering. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close to customers and escalations, and build the processes and playbooks that let the team scale.

What You Will Own

Build

  • The EMEA team. Define the roles and structure the region needs, then recruit, onboard, and develop a team that scales with the business.
  • Standout enterprise support. Make sure strategic customers get fast, expert, and consistent help, with clear ownership from first contact through resolution.
  • Leadership from the front. Stay close to the work, owning critical escalations and coaching the team through the toughest issues.
  • One global team. Partner with the Director and global support leaders to keep coverage and handoffs seamless across regions and time zones.
  • Partnership across the business. Work hand in hand with TAMs, Solutions Engineers, CSMs, Account Managers, and Engineering so customers feel one coordinated Backblaze.
  • Measurement that matters. Set targets and report on response and resolution times, customer satisfaction, escalations, and team health.
  • Continuous improvement. Spot patterns in customer issues, share them with Product and Engineering, and build knowledge and runbooks that make every case faster.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • You have 7+ years in technical support, enterprise support, or customer operations at a B2B SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure company, including 3+ years managing teams.
  • You are a builder at heart: you have hired and grown a team, ideally in a new region or function, and you are equally happy handling an escalation or designing the process behind it.
  • You are technical enough to work with engineers and customers on cloud storage, APIs, networking, data migration, and integrations.
  • You have supported strategic or enterprise customers and know how to stay calm, clear, and credible when the stakes are high.
  • You think in SLAs, escalation paths, and customer health, and turn metrics into action.
  • You love bringing people together, and can influence leaders across Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering.
  • You are based in EMEA, with the flexibility to work with colleagues across time zones.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Fluency in an additional European language.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, or similar support tooling.

Why You Will Love It Here

This is a high-impact leadership role at a fast-growing company, with real ownership, executive visibility, and a direct line to the Director of Enterprise Support. You will set the standards, pick the people, and shape a regional team that moves fast and works as one.

The customers are big, the pace is quick, and the opportunity to build is real. If you like being close to the work and seeing your impact show up in customer trust, retention, and growth, you will fit right in.

Come help us build the best enterprise support experience in cloud storage.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.
